data.title: FUTURE VISION LAB 2026
data.description:
Since its launch in 2020, C-LAB Future Vision Lab has continuously developed FUTURE VISION LAB, an experimental exhibition and performance project dedicated to constructing a dome-based digital architectural environment, with the aim of exploring the visual limits of technological media. Over the past six years, the project has presented more than 200 works.

In 2023, with the support of the Ministry of Culture, it is able to expand and upgrade to “FVL DOME”. In terms of size, it is built as the only large-scale movable DOME with a diameter of 15 meters. The audio-visual hardware and software have undergone several iterations, overcoming the image warping, calibration, mapping, play control, and video pre-production. The immersive projection system achieves a total resolution of up to 8K × 8K. Internally, a double-layer structure conceals the equipment, and a custom-designed acoustically transparent projection membrane has been developed. A refined sound field has been established, featuring a 25.4-channel immersive surround sound system. Moving forward, Future Vision Lab will continue to advance dome-based immersive environments in alignment with international standards, showcasing Taiwan’s creative energy and offering audiences a superior immersive sensory experience.

FUTURE VISION LAB 2026 will take place from April 18 to June 7, 2026, over eight consecutive weekends. Bringing together works from Taiwan, France, Spain, Hungary, Austria, South Korea, Japan, U.S.A., and Canada, the event features a total of 19 works across 16 programs. Through various formats—including exhibitions, screenings, and live performances—the project creates a platform for domestic and international artistic exchange, inviting audiences to step into the FVL DOME and immerse themselves in a sensory experience shaped by the convergence of diverse cultures.
data.description_zh_tw:
自2020年起，C-LAB 未來視覺實驗室持續推動實驗展演計畫「FUTURE VISION LAB」，並以數位實驗建築為起點，打造穹形場域（DOME），持續探索科技媒體的視覺極限，過去六年已進行超過兩百件作品展演。2023年，在文化部支持下完成軟硬體升級，打造直徑15公尺、全臺唯一的巨型移動式戶外沉浸體驗空間「C-LAB穹頂劇場」。沉浸影像投影系統總運算可達 8K × 8K 超高解析度，並克服球形曲面投影在校正、融接、對位、播放控制與影像前製等多重技術挑戰。場域採雙層結構設計，搭配客製透聲投影膜片與25.4聲道環繞聲場環境，打造高規格沉浸式體驗。未來視覺實驗室持續優化穹形場域之創作環境，並向國際標準接軌，展現臺灣在科技藝術領域的創作能量。

「FUTURE VISION LAB 2026」將自 2026年4月18日至6月7日，連續8個週末登場，匯集來自臺灣、法國、西班牙、匈牙利、奧地利、韓國、日本、美國與加拿大等各地精彩作品，共呈現19件作品、16檔節目。透過展覽、播映與現場 Live 演出等多元形式，在跨國創作的交會之中，邀請觀眾走入C-LAB穹頂劇場，沉浸於多元文化交織的感官體驗。

works.title: Genesis
works.note:
Genesis is an immersive dome performance exploring the continuous loop between the micro and macro worlds. The experience starts with countless tiny spheres acting like atoms, bouncing and organizing themselves around the audience. As the dome goes dark, a giant hand appears. Representing a creator, this hand manipulates the atoms, showing how basic elements are shaped into a new world.

From atoms to the creator, and from a barren earth to the cosmos, the artwork reveals a straightforward insight: the vast universe is built from the exact same building blocks as the smallest atom. The end is simply the beginning, and everything exists in an endless loop of creation and rearrangement.

works.note_zh_tw:
《萬象之初》是一場探索「微觀與宏觀同源」的穹頂沉浸式體驗。作品分為四個篇章，帶領觀眾穿梭於無垠的演化迴圈。

起初，穹頂內漂浮著無數微小圓球，它們如原子般以有機的韻律跳動、排列。當光影褪去，一隻象徵「造物主」的巨手隱現於黑暗，撥弄著微塵，賦予虛無初始的秩序。隨後，世界迎來開天闢地的震盪，化作一片蒼茫荒漠。荒漠中央孕育著一顆象徵萬物之源的圓球，當視角穿透球體，我們墜入浩瀚的星雲宇宙。
這片宇宙同樣由無數粒子交織而成。從原子的微觀共舞，到造物主的推演，再到宇宙星辰的宏觀尺度，作品揭示了一個前瞻性的洞見：宇宙即原子，終點即起點。萬事萬物皆在此生生不息的迴圈中，完成無盡的創世與演變。

collectives.name: FPA (Floating Point Art)
collectives.description: FPA is a creative team bridging art, design, and technology, specializing in digital experiences and immersive storytelling. Using contemporary visual language and new media, we explore the "middle ground" between the binary of 0s and 1s—where rational structure meets emotional flow. Through reorganization and experimentation, we integrate visuals, interaction, sound, and space into cohesive experiences. Our goal is to establish a deeper, more human language for the digital age, creating works that are felt, experienced, and deeply connected to people.
collectives.description_zh_tw: 一個跨足藝術、設計與科技的創意團隊，專注於數位體驗與沉浸式敘事。我們以當代視覺語言與新媒材，在 0 與 1 的數位基礎上，探索理性結構與感性流動之間的中間地帶。透過對形式的重組與實驗，我們將視覺、互動、聲音與空間組構成完整的體驗，為當代數位世界建立更具深度、溫度且能與人產生連結的感知語言。

works.title: Future Vision Party #3
works.note: Future Vision Party is a series of self-produced programs by C-LAB Future Vision Lab (Taiwan) beginning in 2023, and it will take place at FUTURE VISION LAB’s dome space. The form of this program will invite artists to jam with each other. In an experimental attempt, they will blend the cutting of images and the switching of sounds in multiple styles in order to break the image and sound frame and create a rich atmosphere. This year, Future Visual Party #3 invites Taiwanese media artists LIU Tung-Yu, sound designer Yude LIN, and Warrick TSAI to collaborate. In this party, it challenges your senses, and stimulates the future imagination of images and sounds.

contributors.name: LIU Tung-Yu
contributors.introduction:
WHEREISCHAPPIE (LIU Tung-Yu) is an audiovisual artist and project manager whose practice spans street dance, performing arts, and media arts. Working across creation, production, and system design, he moves between these fields through multiple intersecting roles. His work focuses on the real-time generation of sound and algorithmic visuals, treating code and self-built interfaces as performative materials. Through structured improvisation, he constructs dynamic audiovisual systems operating between control and randomness. works.title: Mountain Nocturne
works.note:
Mountain Nocturne is a hand-crafted fulldome animation created with modeling clay, manipulated frame by frame like a living oil painting. Set in the Colorado mountains at night, the film is a looping meditation on natural cycles. Snow softly falls under moonlight, animals snooze in their dens, flames flicker and reflect on the trees, birds call from the trees, and the landscape breathes in the moment between winter and spring. In the dome’s darkness, shifting textures of clay evoke the pulse of the mountains beneath the stars.

Music: Slippy BUÑUEL
Co-producer: Craig SAPER
works.note_zh_tw:
《山之夜曲》是一部以手工製作的穹頂動畫作品，採用黏土逐格塑形與拍攝，如同一幅會呼吸的油畫般流動變化。作品場景設定在科羅拉多山區的夜晚，透過循環播放，呈現一段關於自然節律的冥想。在月光之下，細雪緩緩飄落；動物於洞穴中沉睡；火焰閃爍，映照在樹梢之間；鳥鳴自林間傳來；整片山林在冬與春交替的片刻之中輕輕呼吸。在穹頂的幽暗空間裡，黏土不斷變化的質地，喚起群山於星空之下脈動的生命節奏。

音樂：Slippy BUÑUEL
共同製作人：Craig SAPER

contributors.name: Lynn TOMLINSON
contributors.introduction: Lynn TOMLINSON is an award-winning animator and media artist known for her tactile, painterly approach to stop-motion animation. Working with oil-based clay, she crafts moving landscapes that pulse with texture and emotion. Her films often explore ecological interconnection and transformation through hand-made imagery and sound. Mountain Nocturne continues her investigation of natural cycles and the more-than-human world, expanding her practice into the immersive format of fulldome animation. Tomlinson’s work has been exhibited internationally in festivals, museums, and planetariums, and she teaches animation at Towson University in Maryland.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 琳恩．湯琳森為一屢獲殊榮的動畫師與媒體藝術家，以其具觸感、如繪畫般的逐格動畫手法聞名。她運用油性黏土創作出充滿質感與情感脈動的動態景觀，作品經常透過手工影像與聲音探討生態互動與轉化的議題。《山之夜曲》延續她對自然循環與非人世界的探索，並將創作拓展至沉浸式穹頂動畫的形式。湯琳森的作品曾在國際影展、博物館及天文館展出，現於美國馬里蘭州陶森大學教授動畫。

works.title: Where Light Arrives

works.note:
Where Light Arrives is an immersive visual work centered on the phenomenon of light. The concept draws inspiration from the movement of light and the flow of energy within the cosmos—such as the relationship between light and time, the radiance of planets, and the luminous traces along planetary orbits. In this work, light is not only a source of illumination but also a medium that connects time, space, and perception.
Through flowing gradients, circular structures, and extended trajectories of light, the work constructs a continuously shifting visual environment. Light forms pathways within the space, suggesting movement through different layers of space and time. Visuals and sound intertwine to create a bodily sense of perception as viewers move and observe. As light travels across the composition, structures emerge and dissolve, revealing a rhythm reminiscent of cosmic motion.
works.note_zh_tw:
《光所到之處》是一件以光為核心概念的沉浸式影像作品。創作靈感來自宇宙中光的運行與能量的流動，例如光與時間之間的關聯、行星閃耀時所散發的光線，以及行星軌道中延伸的光跡。光在這裡不僅是照亮世界的媒介，也是一種連結時間、空間與感知的存在。
作品透過流動的色彩、環形結構與延展的光之軌跡，構築出一個持續變化的視覺場域。光在空間中形成路徑，彷彿引導觀者穿越不同層次的空間與時間。影像與聲音彼此交織，使觀者在移動與觀看之間產生身體性的感知經驗。隨著光線的流動，畫面中的結構持續生成與消散，呈現出接近宇宙運行節奏的視覺狀態。

contributors.name: Damonxart (Damon HSIEH)
contributors.introduction: Damonxart (Damon HSIEH) is a Taiwan-based digital light artist whose practice explores the relationship between light, color, and spatial perception. Inspired by natural phenomena such as skies, planetary rings, auroras, and optical effects, his works construct immersive visual environments through dynamic gradients and flowing trajectories of light. By combining digital techniques with optical media, Damonxart transforms abstract color research into spatial experiences that evoke a sense of cosmic scale and movement. His works often feature circular structures, luminous flows, and layered color fields that reflect the interaction between time, space, and perception.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 臺灣數位光影藝術家，長期探索光、色彩與空間感知之間的關係。其創作靈感多來自天空、行星、極光與自然光學現象，透過漸層色彩與動態光流構築出具有宇宙感的視覺場域。謝鎮璘擅長運用數位技術與光學媒材，將抽象的色彩研究轉化為沉浸式的空間經驗，作品經常以光的軌跡、環形結構與流動色彩呈現時間與空間的交錯關係。近年亦持續探索數位與實體裝置之間的融合，透過光與色彩重新思考人與空間的感知方式。

works.title: Biche 1
works.note:
In this work, the dome is a breast. It consists of a conversation between a foreign Asian patient who visits a Korean plastic surgery clinic for a breast reduction, and a clinic consultant. In other words, the dome becomes both a breast and a circular stage, where the dialogue between the two women unfolds, endlessly circling the dome. Through this piece, we encounter surreal visuals, view the world from the perspective of the breast, and even fall deep inside it.

To prepare for this work, the artist attended multiple plastic surgery consultations, capturing the authentic conversations, the atmosphere, and the red-tinted imaginations they sparked. These visits positively transformed her project. She was deeply inspired by a consultant with 19 years of experience; her attitude and tone provided far more expertise and reassurance than the male doctors who physically examined me. Although the artist pretends to be a real patient, she wants to take this opportunity to express her sincere gratitude to these women.

Biche 1 is the story of a woman who experiences the sensation that her body is not her own. The title is also inspired by its homonym, abject (卑體). This work bluntly throws out a denial of life and a denial of roots that stem from the denial of the physical body, yet within this very rejection, one might just find another reason to live and to love.

在這件作品中，穹頂被視為一個乳房，並由一段對話構成：一位前往韓國整形外科診所進行縮胸諮詢的外籍亞洲女性，與診所諮詢師之間的交流。換言之，穹頂同時成為乳房與一座環形舞台，兩位女性的對話在其中展開，在場域裡不斷循環；影像將從從「乳房的視角」觀看世界，甚至彷彿墜入其內部深處。

為了準備這件作品，藝術家實際參與了多次整形外科的諮詢過程，記錄下真實的對話、現場氛圍，以及由此引發、帶有紅色調的想像。這些經驗正向地轉化了她的創作方向。她特別受到一位擁有 19 年資歷的諮詢師啟發；相較於實際為她進行身體檢查的男性醫師，這位諮詢師的態度與語氣，反而帶來更多專業感與安心感。儘管藝術家在過程中扮演著「真實患者」，她也希望藉此機會，向這些女性表達誠摯的感謝。

《非體1》講述一位女性感受到自身身體彷彿不再屬於自己的經驗。其標題亦取自與「abject（卑體）」的諧音。作品直白地拋出一種否定：對生命的否定、對根源的否定，而這些否定源自對身體本身的拒絕；然而，也正是在這樣的拒斥之中，或許能夠重新找到另一個活著與去愛的理由。

攝影指導：KIM Maha
攝影師：Jawon
音樂製作：Jaegyu BAE
擬音後製：8F Studio
特效化妝師：Seoyoon JANG

Refusing to remain a distant observer of the landscape, the artist dives into the real-time trails of light. This act of "getting wet together" is a profound gesture of solidarity with the lives of others. By recording these fleeting traces with calligraphic strokes, He seeks to write an anonymous history of the citizens who share our contemporary moment.

works.note_zh_tw:
「所謂幫助，並非為他人撐傘，而是與之共淋一場雨。」 —— 申榮福

contributors.introduction: KIM Tae yeon's work connects time and memory through sound, exploring traces of existence within a reconstructed reality. contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 金泰淵以聲音為主要創作媒介，透過時間與記憶的連結，在重構的現實中探索存在的痕跡。在科技演進與感官共鳴之間，他藉由被記錄與轉化的聲音，將不朽的記憶喚回當下。

contributors.name: Root LEE
contributors.introduction:
Root LEE explores the dialogue between traditional East Asian ink-wash and digital media.
His work pushes the boundaries of Korean calligraphy, reimagining it as a series of site-specific experiments. In a process that is both technical and deeply physical, Root uses real-time camera tracking to capture the light-trails of his body’s movement, transforming them into calligraphic forms. He finds his subject matter in the world’s most delicate details—anything that flickers or trembles becomes a poetic script in his hands. Currently, Root is focused on "virtual placelessness," exploring the aesthetic significance of records as they fade within the rapid flux of modern technology.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 致力於探索東亞傳統水墨與數位媒體的對話，李根耀透過場域特定實驗，重新定義韓國傳統書藝的邊界。其創作擅長運用技術與身體，藉由即時影像追蹤，將身體律動產生的光跡轉化為書寫；對他而言，世間閃爍與顫動的萬物皆為詩意主題。近年來，李根耀聚焦於「虛擬場域性」，在技術疾速異化的浪潮中，探尋消逝紀錄所蘊含的美學意義。

works.title: Drawing Silence

photos.name: 短篇集錦－《描繪寂靜》 - Photo 10

works.note:
Drawing Silence is an immersive dome installation that brings together field recording, algorithmic composition, and mechanical precision. The work attempts to visualize the “negative space” within our auditory landscape—the subtle textures hidden within the folds of silence.

At the core of the concept lies a particular perspective on silence: rather than treating it simply as the “absence of sound,” the work approaches silence as an accumulation of unintentional resonances that fill the environment. The subtle sounds collected from different locations are not treated merely as recordings, but as rich data to be decoded. Inspired by the minimalism of early computer art and the geometric elegance of architectural drawings, the work bridges the unpredictable fluctuations of the natural world and the strict logic of software.

The central process of the piece is the translation of sound into form. A custom-designed system analyzes acoustic data and converts variations in frequency and amplitude into complex geometric trajectories. These paths appear as physical traces through the logic of a drawing machine. The regular rhythm of the plotter and the marks left by friction become a record of careful observation directed toward the intangible nature of sound.

Within the vast canvas of the dome, these movements are inscribed as living traces. Calculated algorithms encounter physical resistance; sound gradually takes form, and silence becomes something visible.
works.note_zh_tw:
《描繪寂靜》是一件沉浸式穹頂影像作品，結合了環境聲音採集、演算法作曲與機械精密控制。作品試圖將我們聽覺環境中的「負空間」具象化——也就是潛藏在寂靜之中的細膩聲音紋理。此作品的核心概念，建立在對「沉默」的一種獨特觀點上：它不將沉默單純視為「沒有聲音」，而是將其理解為由無意間產生的共鳴所累積、並充滿於環境中的存在。從不同場域蒐集而來的細微聲響，不只是單純的錄音素材，而是蘊含豐富資訊、等待被解讀的數據。作品受到早期電腦藝術的極簡風格，以及建築製圖中幾何美學的啟發，在自然世界中難以預測的變化，與軟體邏輯的嚴謹秩序之間，建立起一座橋樑。

《描繪寂靜》的核心過程，是將聲音轉譯為視覺形式。一套客製化系統會分析聲學數據，並將頻率與振幅的變化，轉換為複雜的幾何軌跡。這些軌跡透過繪圖機的運作邏輯，化為具體可見的物理痕跡。繪圖機規律的節奏，以及筆尖與表面摩擦所留下的線條，成為一種細膩觀察的紀錄，指向聲音那難以捉摸的本質。在穹頂廣闊的畫布之中，這些運動被銘刻為持續生成的痕跡。當精密計算的演算法遇上物理世界的阻力，聲音逐漸顯現出形體，而寂靜，也因此變得可被看見。

contributors.name: barbe_generative_diary
contributors.introduction: barbe_generative_diary records the sounds embedded in phenomena around the world through field recording. Using environmental sounds and vibration data as source material, it reconstructs invisible sonic landscapes through program code and drawing machines. Through this ongoing process, it explores new possibilities for creative expression.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 透過田野錄音，採集並紀錄嵌入於世界各地現象中的聲音。以環境聲響與振動數據為素材，藉由程式碼與繪圖裝置，重構出肉眼不可見的聲音地景。透過持續進行的實踐過程，進一步探索藝術創作表達的新可能性。

works.title: Temporal Strata
works.note:
Temporal Strata takes the materiality of time as its point of departure, treating time as strata capable of sedimentation, disturbance, and continuous formation. Within the immersive field of the dome, sound and image are woven into a single perceptual space, displacing linear narrative as the mode through which time is apprehended. Time is instead progressively recalibrated in the act of looking and listening, as rhythms elongate and restructure and attention shifts between micro-variations. The work invites consciousness to contract into a single point, converting time from abstract measure into a state perceived through sound and image. Amid the accumulation of texture and the collapse of space, one begins to gauge the sense of presence that each breath inscribes.

《時間層理》以時間的物質性為出發點，將其視為可沉積、可擾動、持續生成的層理。在穹頂的沉浸式場域中，聲音與影像被編織為同一個感知空間，使時間不再以線性敘事被理解，而是在觀看與聆聽的過程中逐步被重新校準，當節奏被拉長、重組，注意力在細微變化之間移位。在作品中，想像意識成為一個點，讓時間從抽象刻度轉為以音像來感知的狀態，從紋理堆疊、空間坍縮的變化中，測量出呼吸所標記的存在感。

contributors.name: Jie LIOU
contributors.introduction: A Taiwanese visual director, new media artist, and founder of FPA (Floating Point Art). Specializing in visual concept design and motion graphics, he merges sound and image to explore the philosophical and symbolic dimensions of audiovisual expression.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 新媒體藝術家、導演，以及浮點設計的創辦人。他的創作遊走於藝術與商案之間，透過精準的系統邏輯與深刻的敘事，探討時間、感知及空間的本質。他擅長以科技為媒介，將創意設計轉化為富含深度與沉浸感的視覺體驗。

contributors.name: WU Ping-Sheng
contributors.introduction:
A Taiwanese media artist, a Lecturer at National Tsing Hua University, specializes in computer music, audiovisual performances, and installation art. His works have been featured at various art festivals and exhibitions in festivals across Asia, Europe, and North America.

As a sound artist, Ping Seng was nominated for the Digital Art Awards Taipei in 2015 and 2016. He was also a member of the production team of Render Ghost, the first prize-winner of the 6th Digital Art Performance Awards. His work Transonic was presented in Barcelona, Spain in 2017. He also served as the sound designer for the performance Unconditional Love and Fact at the National Theater & Concert Hall, and participated in the production of Electric Indigo, a special program celebrating the 30th anniversary of the National Theater & Concert Hall with LIM Giong as the artistic director. He worked as an artist-in-residence in Korea (2018) and New York (2019 at the Triangle Arts Association), visited the Centre Pompidouon’s IRCAM on behalf of the C-LAB in June 2019, and presented his sound performance at the Nuit Blanche Taipei. In 2020, he took part in the production of The Scenery of Little Light at the invitation of the National Taichung Theater, and serves as the music and sound director for noiseKitchen, a team focusing on new media art.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw:
藝術家，同時為國立清華大學藝術學院學士班專任講師，創作為電腦音樂、音像演出、媒體裝置。作品發表於臺灣雙年展、臺灣國際光影藝術節、臺灣燈會、月津港燈節、台北白晝之夜等活動，演出、共製及藝術駐村計劃於亞洲、歐洲和北美地區的聯展和藝術節中展出。

collectives.name: FPA (Floating Point Art)
collectives.description: FPA is a creative team bridging art, design, and technology, specializing in digital experiences and immersive storytelling. Using contemporary visual language and new media, we explore the "middle ground" between the binary of 0s and 1s—where rational structure meets emotional flow. Through reorganization and experimentation, we integrate visuals, interaction, sound, and space into cohesive experiences. Our goal is to establish a deeper, more human language for the digital age, creating works that are felt, experienced, and deeply connected to people.
collectives.description_zh_tw: 一個跨足藝術、設計與科技的創意團隊，專注於數位體驗與沉浸式敘事。我們以當代視覺語言與新媒材，在 0 與 1 的數位基礎上，探索理性結構與感性流動之間的中間地帶。透過對形式的重組與實驗，我們將視覺、互動、聲音與空間組構成完整的體驗，為當代數位世界建立更具深度、溫度且能與人產生連結的感知語言。

works.title: Temporal
works.note:
Fleeing imminent death from an incurable disease, an astronaut takes refuge in a slower space-time continuum in the hope of returning to see his young daughter grown to adulthood.
Featuring David La Haye with original music by Karkwa, TEMPORAL is a 360-degree immersive cinematic experience that invites viewers to feel a new dimension of time and love. 
“The distinction between past, present and future is only a stubbornly persistent illusion.”           
-Albert Einstein

Production: PHOSPHEN (Jean-François ÉTHIER, Dominic ST-AMAND)
Original Music: Karkwa
Actors: David LA HAYE, Megan LAMONTAGNE, Ines DEFOSSÉ, Melie-Rose GAZÉ

*This film explores themes of intimacy and gender identity. Viewer discretion is advised.
works.note_zh_tw:
為了逃避不治之症，一名太空人躲進了一個較慢的時空緩衝區，希望能在那裡等待時光流逝，最終再見到他長大成人的女兒。
《時空》由 David La Haye 領銜主演，並由 Karkwa 樂團打造原創音樂。這場 360 度沉浸式電影體驗，正如愛因斯坦所言：「過去、現在與未來之間的區別，只是一種頑固且持久的幻象。」作品將帶領觀眾超越現實界線，深刻感受時間與愛的全新維度。

collectives.name: PHOSPHEN
collectives.description: PHOSPHEN is a creator of content and a designer of virtual reality technologies and immersive environments. At its core, its purpose is to craft unique experiences through existing immersive technologies… or those yet to be invented. Whether through interactivity, sensory engagement, or immersive audiovisual design, its ongoing pursuit is to create powerful emotional connections that audiences will remember for a long time.
collectives.description_zh_tw: PHOSPHEN 是一家內容創作公司，致力於設計虛擬實境技術與沉浸式環境。核心宗旨在於透過現有或尚未被發明的沉浸式技術，打造獨一無二的體驗。無論是透過交互作用、感官參與或是沉浸式影音設計，其不斷追求的是創造出能讓觀眾長久銘記的強大情感連結。

works.title: NEW MODERN TIMES
works.note:
NEW MODERN TIMES: A Generative Audio-Visual Odyssey!

When Taiwanese cultural heritage meets the digital frenzy of the AI generation, a sensory storm like no other is about to sweep through C-LAB! NEW MODERN TIMES is a generative immersive masterpiece centered on the soul of Taiwan. It shatters the boundaries of reality, weaving natural landscapes, industrial marvels, traditional temple processions, and neon-lit night markets with AI mythology and deep-space futures into a witty, thought-provoking visual epic.

Under the massive immersive dome, you will witness the raw, untamed power of AI-generated visuals—a cultural collision of mischief, radical creativity, and artistic fusion. The visionaries behind the storm produced by Hello World, featuring the groundbreaking visual artistry of Dimension Plus and AI pioneers Hello Edo!. The soundtrack is a dream collaboration: from the celestial voice of Paiwan singer Kivi and the high-octane energy of  Mr. Skin, to the legendary soundscapes of electronic pioneer LIM Giong. Together, they bridge tribes and the cosmos, tradition and the future.

《新摩登時代》當臺灣文化意象撞擊 AI 世代的數位狂想！

《新摩登時代》是一部以臺灣文化為核心的「奇想生成式沉浸影音作品」。它打破現實邊界，將自然環境、工業製造、廟會遶境、夜市印象，乃至於 AI 神話與未來太空，重新編織成一段幽默詼諧卻充滿啟發的視覺史詩。

在巨大的穹形場域之下，你將感受 AI 影像生成的狂放力量，體驗集結「惡搞、創造、融合」於一身的文化衝擊。由初未來領銜製作，集結科技藝術代表超維度 與 AI 影像先鋒江戶未來世。音樂陣容更是夢幻：從排灣族天籟歌手 Kivi、潮流電音 DJ 賴皮，到傳奇音樂大師林強。頂尖藝術家跨界聯手，打造出這場橫跨部落與宇宙、傳統與未來的《新摩登時代》。

contributors.name: Kivi
contributors.introduction:
Paiwan singer-songwriter Kivi comes from Bayao Village in Manzhou Township, Pingtung, Taiwan. With a fashion-forward presence reminiscent of FKA twigs, she leaves a strong impression both visually and vocally. The first time you hear her sing, it is hard not to be struck by the powerful energy contained within her petite frame.
Kivi’s soft and lyrical voice evokes shared memories and emotional resonance across generations of Indigenous communities—like a gentle reminder or blessing from an elder. This quality has earned her a devoted following, with several of her YouTube videos surpassing one million views.In June 2022, she released her debut Indigenous-language album Padiyudr, which was nominated for three major awards at the 34th Golden Melody Awards: Best Indigenous Language Album, Best Indigenous Language Singer, and Album of the Year.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 排灣族唱作人 kivi 來自屏東滿洲鄉八瑤部落，外型宛如 FKA Twigs 般時尚。初聽見她的聲音，也總讓人驚艷她瘦小身軀裡蘊含的巨大能量。kivi 輕柔婉轉的歌聲勾勒出不同世代原住民群體生活的記憶共感，像是老人家溫柔的叮嚀或祝福。這樣的特質讓她擁有眾多粉絲及數支 YouTube 破百萬點閱影片。2022年6月發行第一張族語創作專輯《 分水嶺 Padiyudr 》，入圍第 34 屆金曲獎 最佳原住民專輯、最佳原住民歌手、年度專輯等三大獎。

contributors.name: LIM Giong
contributors.introduction: Musicworker. Mainly produces music scores of fiction films and documentaries and has also worked on scores of shorts, commercials, dance performances, light installations and VR; and has tried to collaborate and exchange ideas with artists from various fields. He is exploring abstract electronic tones and experimental and ambient music creation – sailing through reality and imagination, existence and dreams, the way it is to view our life.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 音樂工作者，主要製作電影和紀錄片配樂，也曾參與短片、廣告、舞蹈、燈光裝置藝術、VR等配樂，嘗試與各領域的藝術家交流合作，近期探索抽象電子聲響與實驗及環境音樂創作，虛實幻影，戲夢人生，應作如是觀。

contributors.name: Mr. Skin
contributors.introduction: Mr. Skin is not only a champion in various music competitions but also the founder of the renowned nightclub Cocco & Co. in Kaohsiung, often hailed as the city’s liveliest club. Additionally, he serves as the music director for the famous MUSE nightclub. Constantly creating, performing, and hosting parties, Mr. Skin plays multiple roles across vibrant venues. In response to nightclubs’ restrictions on Mandarin songs, he founded Mandarin Homework, a project aimed at rekindling pride and identity of the mother tongue.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 賴皮 MR.SKIN不僅是各種音樂競賽的常勝軍，更是有「高雄最嗨夜店」之稱Cocco & Co.的創辦人，以及知名夜店MUSE的音樂總監。閒不下來的賴皮平時除了創作和演出，更經常舉辦派對活動，在眾多五光十色的場域中擔任多重角色。賴皮為了抗爭夜店不能放中文歌曲這件事，於是創立了「國語作業簿」，「國語作業簿是想喚醒大家對於自己語言的認同。」​​。

collectives.name: Dimension Plus
collectives.description: A new media art collective based in Taiwan and Hong Kong, exploring the relationship between art and science through cross-disciplinary experiments. Their works mix old and new media to address social, cultural, and ethical issues. By combining traditional and contemporary mediums, they aim to reflect on the impact of technology while pushing creative boundaries. Notable awards include the Best Design of the Year of Taiwan Golden Pin Design Award, Tokyo TDC, Asia Digital Arts Awards Japan and Gold Award of Design for Asia Award Hong Kong, German Design Award 2018 etc.

collectives.description: A creative collective deeply fascinated by AI-generated imagery. The members come from across Asia, passionate about using artificial intelligence for visual storytelling, drawing inspiration from art, culture, machinery, and futuristic visions of cyborg worlds. Their works have been featured in prominent exhibitions, including Modern Times and New Century Ukiyo-e at NTT Arts NOVA (National Taichung Theater, 2025), 2024 Hello, Human! exhibition, 2024 TTXC《G.A.M.E.》Culture Stew in Finland and Hong Kong, Microwave International New Media Arts Festival (Hong Kong, 2023)

Renowned for its expertise in international crossover collaborations, Hello World brings together leading Asian curators and producers in the field of technological art. In addition to representing artists, Hello World curates immersive exhibitions and fosters interdisciplinary collaborations at major international venues such as SXSW, MUTEK, MOCA Taipei, National Taichung Theater, National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts, and West Kowloon Cultural District.

works.title: The Pond Nation Election
works.note:
Breaking News! The Pond Nation’s first-ever presidential election is about to begin!
The retired Frog King has announced that the next leader will be chosen by the will of the people rather than royal succession. From Minister Night Heron, who flew abroad to study voting systems, to Duck the Secretary, who nearly caused a hilarious mix-up during preparations—the entire community is buzzing with excitement. Will the next leader be the Frog Prince, a hidden talent among the residents, or a mysterious "underground" candidate? The outcome is entirely in your hands!

The Pond Nation Election is adapted from Tellingtent’s popular workshop series, Flamingo Tells Stories, and transformed into an immersive DOME experience. Children will step into the role of Pond Nation citizens, using their own ID cards to cast their ballots. By combining storytelling with simulated voting, the program introduces children to the concepts of democracy. Each session features a dynamic ending that changes based on the live voting results, allowing participants to experience the true power of choice. works.note:
With contemporary artist YAO Jui-Chung’s series, Mini Meme, as the creative core, Mount Ecstasy extends from YAO’s peculiar observations and whimsical imaginings of Taiwanese society, technological development, and history to reconstruct a fictional universe that merges mythical allegory with contemporary society. This universe echoes Mount Meru, a symbol revered in Buddhism and Hinduism as the central axis of the universe, which is transformed into Mount Ecstasy. This contemporary Taiwanese spiritual landscape is a hybrid world that intertwines maritime legends, information illusions, and spiritual parties, presenting a multi-faceted revelry of illusory reality.

With YAO as the original creator and concept director, the artwork is co-created by new media artist Yi KUO and experimental electronic musician Meuko Meuko. Deploying 3D game engine technology and immersive surround sound effects, the work extends the sci-fi mythology and narrative style established in the pair’s previous audiovisual performances, Invisible General and Ghost Island and reinterprets the scenes and characters from the paintings in the series, Mini Meme. This site-specific work designed for the immersive fulldome venue, FVL DOME, invites viewers to enjoy an experience that blends mythical imaginings and audiovisual illusions from a first-person perspective.

《虛迷山》以當代藝術家姚瑞中的《小迷因》系列為創作核心，延伸其中對台灣社會、科技發展與歷史的荒誕觀察與奇想，重構出一個融合神話寓言與當代政治的虛構宇宙。此宇宙呼應佛教與印度神話中象徵宇宙結構的「須彌山」，並將其轉化為屬於當代台灣的「虛迷山」——一座交織海國傳說、資訊幻象與靈性派對的虛實混種世界。

作品由當代藝術家姚瑞中擔任原作與概念指導，邀請新媒體藝術家郭一與實驗電子音樂創作者 Meuko! Meuko! 共同創作，並結合NONTECH、XTRUX、黃偉等單位共同製作，透過3D影像與遊戲引擎技術，為沉浸空間量身打造，重新詮釋《小迷因》畫作中的場景與角色。

觀眾將以第一人稱視角，進入一場融合神話敘事、數位幻覺與聲音儀式的虛迷之旅。全作以「宇宙之始」、「海國爭霸」、「人間派對」、「科技修仙」、「轉生異世界」等九個章節構成，從虛構海域中的虎龍大戰，到島嶼的生成、數位靈修與跨維度歡愉之島的開展，共構一座象徵當代精神景觀與信仰碎片的資訊須彌山，一場關於虛迷現實的多重狂歡。

works.title: Stalking for Errors
works.note:
No single viewpoint reveals the whole picture.

This misplaced archive frames human civilization as a subjective construct. Audiences are enveloped in a process of civilizational exposition built through sound. While imagery unfolds across the dome, audio from every direction narrates conflicting versions of reality. History is built not on linear progress, but on misreadings, bias, and power. What is real and what is fake? Perhaps only the error itself remains—the void left when different perspectives cancel each other out.

Stalking for Errors expands the core of Noctivagant encyclopedia into an immersive dome, where the audience’s movement becomes an active act of editing and reading. It amplifies a human limitation: no perspective is entirely wrong, yet none is ever complete.

As viewers move to eliminate informational errors, their sensory limits only create new gaps in understanding. Reality is no longer external. Instead, within the disorientation of interference and overlap, meaning is defined entirely by the viewer's path.
works.note_zh_tw:
沒有任何一個位置，能讓我們看清全部。

這是一份關於人類文明如何被主觀建造的錯置檔案。觀眾被包覆在一座由聲音構築的文明闡述過程中。影像在穹頂上播放，但每個方位的聲音都述說著不同版本的真實。歷史並非線性的進步，而是由誤讀、偏見與權力堆疊而成。什麼是真實呢？什麼是虛假呢？唯一存在的可能只有誤差本身而已。是多種視角相互抵銷後留下的空缺。

《誤差追獵》將前作《百科夜行》的核心結構擴展至沉浸式的穹形場域，使觀眾的身體移動成為主動的剪輯與閱讀。進一步擴展所謂沒有哪個位置是錯的，也沒有哪個位置是完整的人類缺憾。

當觀眾試圖透過移動來追獵並消除訊息誤差，視覺與聽覺的侷限卻不斷製造新的理解斷層。真實不再存於外部，而是在干擾、延遲與重疊的迷失過程中，由觀眾的移動路徑定義出當下的意義。

進入聲音與影像錯置的領域，進入知識體內部那不斷生成的誤差。

works.title: NOOSPHERE
works.note: The audiovisual fulldome performance Noosphere examines the intricate relationship between the noosphere—the global sphere of human thought—and its profound influence on climate change. Initially a utopian concept, the work confronts the dual impact of its realization through cyberspace: beneath the digital convenience lies a harsh reality of massive energy consumption required to sustain the ever-increasing demand for bandwidth and speed. Within the dome, a swarm of points continually rearranges itself around the audience, creating a visual opposition between natural phenomena like tornados and rain and the angular, rigid architectural forms that represent humanity’s influence on the primal forces of nature.
works.note_zh_tw: 《意識之維》深入探討「人類精神圈」——全球人類集體意識領域——對當代氣候變遷的深遠影響。作品從最初的烏托邦構想出發，直視數位文明在網路空間具現後產生的雙重衝擊：在科技便利背後，是追求極速頻寬所導致的巨大能耗與環境負荷。在穹頂中，無數點陣在觀眾周圍重組，將龍捲風、暴雨等自然現象與稜角僵硬的建築幾何進行視覺對抗，隱喻人類力量對原始自然的干預。

works.title: Panphony: Circular Movement
works.note:
Panphony: Circular Movement is an audiovisual work that builds a space for sound, aiming to transform the act of “listening together” into collective listening and a spatial experience. Panphony means “a space for all sounds.” At the threshold between the virtual and the real, it constructs and sets diverse sounds in motion, creating a condition in which sound and space define one another. Within this space, listening expands beyond an individual experience into a shared moment where self and others become connected.

Panphony’s space operates through repetitive, circular movement. Like the repetition of meeting and parting, the quantum spin of electrons, and the Earth’s rotation and the revolution of planets, circulation is not a static return but a motion that carries gradual change. It holds both “returning” and “newness,” functioning as a structure that reconnects past and present, self and others.

Within this circular movement, Panphony attempts a virtual–physical structuring of music. Virtual sound structures built up by the performer are placed as architectural elements that perform sound through circular movement, constructing the space as it unfolds. These sound structures function as an architectural score grounded in sound; space and sound define one another, forming a shared sense of place where everyone is situated together. Field recordings collected from Korea, Taiwan, and other locations drift through the real space, layering the time and landscapes of different places within the distances between individuals. As these wandering sounds pass between audience members, they reveal and connect one another’s presence.

In Panphony: Circular Movement, audiences encounter this from their own positions and sensitivities, while also moving through the same flow together. This shared experience leads to a new listening community, and through circular movement and change, “a space for all sounds” is composed as something sensed collectively.
works.note_zh_tw:
《眾聲場：環形運動》是一件以聲音為核心建構空間的沉浸式體驗作品，試圖將「一起聆聽」轉化為一種集體性的感知經驗與空間實踐。Panphony（此譯「眾聲場」）意指「所有聲音的空間」，在虛擬與現實的交界之處，作品讓多重聲響生成並運動，使聲音與空間彼此定義、相互形塑。在此之中，聆聽不再只是個體經驗，而擴展為一個共享的時刻，讓自我與他者產生連結。

《眾聲場》的演出運作建立於重複且循環的運動之上。如同相遇與離別的反覆、電子的量子自旋、地球自轉與行星公轉，循環並非靜止的回返，而是一種帶有漸進變化的流動。它同時承載「回歸」與「新生」，作為一種結構，重新連結過去與現在、自我與他者。

在這樣的環形運動中，《眾聲場》嘗試建構一種虛擬與實體交織的音樂結構。由表演者在空間中的位置，所建構的虛擬聲音結構被作為建築元素，透過環形運動發出聲響，展演過程中逐步構築整體空間。這些聲音結構如同以聲音為基礎的建築樂譜，使空間與聲音相互界定，形成一種眾人共在的場所感。來自韓國、臺灣及其他地區的田野錄音，穿梭在真實空間當中，在觀眾彼此之間的距離裡，層層疊加不同地域的時間與風景。當這些流動的聲音穿越人群，也讓彼此的存在被感知與連結。

在《眾聲場：環形運動》中，觀眾從各自的位置與感知出發，同時也一同置身於同一股流動之中。這種共享的經驗，形塑出一種新的聆聽社群；透過循環與變化，「所有聲音的空間」得以被共同感知與生成。

contributors.name: Kohui
contributors.introduction:
Kohui explores relationships shaped through sound, with a focus on the act of sensing it. Observing natural phenomena, forms, methods, and the structures of today’s technologies, he designs algorithms that generate relationships between the predictable and the unpredictable. He reconfigures these relationships to expand ways of sensing sound, building his perspective on nature, the human, and sound.
He has presented audiovisual performances in Korea and abroad, including at ACT Festival, WeSA Festival, Unfold X 2025, ISEA 2025, MUTEK Montreal, and in Tokyo. He has also participated in group exhibitions at the Seoul Museum of Art, the National Asia Culture Center, and Platform-L, among others. He was selected as a HYUNDAI ZER01NE Creator in 2022 and founded the artist collective TAKA in 2024. He has also served as an adjunct professor at the Korea National University of Arts.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw:
韓國音像藝術家，以前衛、獨特的創作風格聞名，作品融合影像、音樂與互動元素，探索數位虛擬與真實世界的邊界。其創作類型包含生成藝術，致力於研究音像藝術的本質及其可能性。
他曾在韓國國內外發表影音演出，包括 ACT 藝術節、WeSA 藝術節、Unfold X 2025、ISEA 2025、蒙特婁及東京 MUTEK 藝術節。他也曾參與首爾市立美術館、國立亞洲文化殿堂（ACC）及 Platform-L 等地的聯展。他於 2022 年入選為現代汽車（HYUNDAI）ZER01NE 創作者，並於 2024 年創立藝術團體 TAKA。此外，他亦曾擔任韓國藝術綜合大學（K-ARTS）的兼任教授。

works.title: Substratum
works.note:
Substratum delves into the hidden layers of existence and identity, those invisible strata that simultaneously ground our existence and stand as thresholds we must encounter and transform through growth. This work approaches transcendence not as a linear ascent but as a cyclical process: an ongoing movement of frag   mentation and re-formation in which each passage leads to a renewed self, continually seeking its next point of crossing. 

Rather than presenting a fixed narrative, Substratum invites the audience to engage in deep focus and introspection through its immersive visual language of light and movement. The soundscape weaves together field recordings from Buddhist temples, including footsteps, bells, and distant fragments of chanting, which can only be perceived through attentive listening. By dissolving the boundaries between inner and outer perception, this work evokes a meditative state, allowing the audience to experience the fluidity of space and the malleability of perception.

Audiovisual composition: Kati KATONA
Spatial audio advisor: Ákos LOVÁSZ
works.note_zh_tw:
《藏識》探索存在與自我的隱藏層面，那些既是支撐我們存在的根基，也是我們在成長過程中必須去面對、並轉化的關卡。作品將超越理解為一個循環的過程，而非直線的攀升：在持續的分裂與重構中，每一次都帶來更新的自我，不斷追尋並跨越下一個關卡。

本作品沒有固定的敘事，而是透過光與律動的視覺語言，引導觀眾進入深度的專注及內省。聲音織入了需極度專心才能察覺到佛教寺院田野錄音的內容，包括腳步聲、鐘聲以及遙遠的誦經片段等等。作品透過模糊內在與外在感知的界線，營造一種冥想般的氛圍，邀請觀眾體驗空間的流動性與感知的可塑性。

影音創作：凱蒂．卡托納
空間音訊顧問：阿科斯．洛瓦斯

contributors.name: Kati KATONA
contributors.introduction: Kati KATONA is a new media artist based in Budapest, Hungary. Her practice explores the intersection of technology, perception, and space through generative art, interactive installations, and projection mapping. Drawing inspiration from natural forms, biomorphic structures, and algorithmic systems, she creates meditative visual environments that invite introspection and a sense of presence. Through her immersive works, she explores how digital media can transform spatial perception and blur the boundaries between the physical and virtual realms.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 來自匈牙利布達佩斯的新媒體藝術家，其創作透過生成藝術、互動裝置與光雕投影，探索科技、知覺與空間的交會。靈感來源包括自然形態、有機結構與演算法系統，她以此打造冥想般的視覺環境，邀請觀眾進入自我沉思並感受當下存在。透過沉浸式作品，凱蒂探討數位媒體如何改變空間感知，並模糊物理與虛擬之間的界線。

works.title: Deep-Rooted
works.note:
Deep-Rooted is an immersive media art work that narrates the story of new plant life evolved on constantly shifting ground. Unfolding within the non-human temporality of soil and microbes, the work positions humans, AI, and plants as equal narrative agents.

The piece guides visitors into a vast subterranean world where roots have developed resilience against earthquakes. Rather than being rigidly anchored, these roots sway and dance with the ground's movement, forming a living neural network that absorbs vibrations. The installation utilizes a 360-degree dome projection and spatial audio to create a powerful physical sensation, combining seismic low frequencies with plant biosignals.

Through this multisensory experience, the work reimagines earthquakes not as disasters, but as catalysts for biological evolution. It invites the audience to undergo an epistemological shift—deconstructing their anthropocentric sensorium to see the world through the eyes of plant beings. By witnessing the wisdom of roots that find balance amid instability, Deep-Rooted proposes a new ecological imagination for the coexistence of humans, nature, and technology.
works.note_zh_tw:
《深層根木》是一件講述在不斷變動的土地上誕生新植物的生命故事。作品以土壤與微生物的非人類時間性展開，將人類、人工智慧與植物置於平等的敘事角色之中。

作品引領觀眾進入廣袤的地下世界，感受根系如何在地震中發展出韌性。這些根系並非固守不動，而是隨著地面的搖晃舞動，形成一個吸收震動的活體神經網絡。作品透過 360 度穹頂投影影像與空間音訊，結合地震低頻震動與植物生物訊號，帶給觀眾強烈的身體感受。

透過多感官的沉浸體驗，帶領觀眾重新思考：地震不再僅是災難，而是生物進化的催化力。透過知識觀點的轉換，打破以人類為中心的感官認知，邀請觀眾從植物的視角重新看世界。透過觀察在不穩定環境中仍能保持平衡的根系智慧，《深層根木》嘗試提出人類、自然與科技共生的新生態想像。

collectives.name: AINO X Yunyoung JANG
collectives.description: AINO X Yunyoung JANG is a media art duo formed to explore the organic connections between the inner human world and the external ecological environment through technology. By fusing AINO’s systematization of ‘emotion-sensation’ and Jang’s exploration of ‘relational-ecological networks,’ they create immersive, multi-sensory experiences. AINO (Sound Art) builds systems that translate immaterial emotions into material experiences, while Yunyoung JANG (Visual Art) envisions future ecosystems where humans, animals, and AI coexist. Their collaboration seeks to dissolve the dichotomies between subject and world, proposing a post-humanocentric perspective.
collectives.description_zh_tw: 藝術家雙人組 AINO X Yunyoung JANG 致力於透過科技探索人類內在世界與外部生態環境之間的有機連結。結合 AINO 對「情感-感覺」的系統化研究與 Yunyoung 對「關係-生態網絡」的探索，他們的作品試圖消解主體與世界之間的二元對立。聲音藝術家 AINO 建構能將非物質情感轉化為物質感官體驗的系統，而影像藝術家 Yunyoung JANG 則構想人類、動物與 AI 共存的未來生態系。他們的創作欲打破「主體」與「世界」的二分法，企圖提出一種後人類中心的觀點。

works.title: Following the deer
works.note:
Following the deer has been imagined as an audiovisual poem. This work describes the various stages of an archery deer-hunting session as it might have been practised 400 years ago by members of the Siraya tribe. Tracking and tracing, reading animal footprints and deciphering the flight of the birds, invocation and thanks to the spirits of the forest, stalking and pursuit, death and sharing, are all crucial stages in this ancestral practice and highlight the ecological implications of a practice concerned with preserving natural balances in a world seen through a whole system of interrelationships. Understanding how to live in a world in which all living beings are linked may enable us to reconfigure our imaginations for viable futures. This work is an invitation to enter the forest in search of the essential.

Supported by: Soulangh Cultural Park, JS Ltd.
works.note_zh_tw:
《循鹿》可被想像為一首視覺詩篇作品。作品描述了四百年前西拉雅族成員可能進行的傳統弓箭狩獵鹿群的各個階段。追蹤與尋跡、解讀動物足跡與鳥類飛行軌跡、向森林之靈祈求並表達感謝、悄然接近與追捕、獵物的獵殺與分享——這些都是祖先狩獵實踐中的重要環節，也凸顯了這種行為對維護自然平衡的生態意涵。在萬物相互聯繫的世界中，理解如何與所有生命共存，或許能啟發我們重新想像永續的未來。邀請觀眾透過影像，走入森林、尋找那份最根本的本質。

支持單位：蕭壠文化園區、JS Ltd.

contributors.name: Ralph KILLHERTZ
contributors.introduction: Ralph KILLHERTZ is an experimental composer, sound artist and developer of new musical technologies. He has shared the world of musical creation with the recording. He holds a Master in Electroacoustic Composition in “CSKG-Centro Superior de Enseñanzas Musicales Katarina Gurska” in Madrid. Passionate about the sound and the perception that the human being has of him, his work as a composer is based on the search and the analysis and functioning of the mechanisms of the perception, as well as in the creation of strategies that allow to convert the attentive listening in a mechanism of composition.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 基爾赫茲是聲音藝術家，馬德里高等音樂教育中心碩士。他將音樂創作與錄音技術結合，對於聲音以及人類對其聲音的感知充滿熱情；他的作曲主要基於對感知機制的探索、分析與運作研究，並致力於開發特定策略，將「專注聆聽」轉化為作曲的驅動機制。

contributors.name: Sandrine DEUMIER
contributors.introduction: Sandrine DEUMIER is a multidisciplinary artist working in the fields of performance, poetry and video art, whose work investigates post-futurist themes through the development of aesthetic forms related to digital imaginaries. Passionate about digital storytelling, immersive artistic experiences, ecological concerns and speculative futures, her work focuses on imagining new ways of inhabiting the world using new technologies from an animist perspective.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 桑德琳．德米耶是一位跨領域藝術家，從事表演、詩歌和錄像藝術，作品透過數位想像的美學形式，研究後未來主義主題。通過互動敘事進行故事講述，發展以生命想像為中心的詩意虛擬視覺作品。生態關懷和未來推演是她研究的核心。通過新媒體創作，從泛靈論觀點想像新世界的生存途徑，自然平衡優先於掠奪，積累並無限生長。

contributors.name: Kohui
contributors.introduction:
Kohui explores relationships shaped through sound, with a focus on the act of sensing it. Observing natural phenomena, forms, methods, and the structures of today’s technologies, he designs algorithms that generate relationships between the predictable and the unpredictable. He reconfigures these relationships to expand ways of sensing sound, building his perspective on nature, the human, and sound.
He has presented audiovisual performances in Korea and abroad, including at ACT Festival, WeSA Festival, Unfold X 2025, ISEA 2025, MUTEK Montreal, and in Tokyo. He has also participated in group exhibitions at the Seoul Museum of Art, the National Asia Culture Center, and Platform-L, among others. He was selected as a HYUNDAI ZER01NE Creator in 2022 and founded the artist collective TAKA in 2024. He has also served as an adjunct professor at the Korea National University of Arts.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw:
韓國音像藝術家，以前衛、獨特的創作風格聞名，作品融合影像、音樂與互動元素，探索數位虛擬與真實世界的邊界。其創作類型包含生成藝術，致力於研究音像藝術的本質及其可能性。
他曾在韓國國內外發表影音演出，包括 ACT 藝術節、WeSA 藝術節、Unfold X 2025、ISEA 2025、蒙特婁及東京 MUTEK 藝術節。他也曾參與首爾市立美術館、國立亞洲文化殿堂（ACC）及 Platform-L 等地的聯展。他於 2022 年入選為現代汽車（HYUNDAI）ZER01NE 創作者，並於 2024 年創立藝術團體 TAKA。此外，他亦曾擔任韓國藝術綜合大學（K-ARTS）的兼任教授。

contributors.name: MONOCOLOR
contributors.introduction: MONOCOLOR alias Marian Essl is a Vienna based audiovisual artist. He explores the interrelations between sound and image in both performance-based and installation-based works. His fully generative, algorithmically created imagery oscillates between fluid, organic textures and rigid structures. He focuses on the relation between sound, image, light and space, aiming to create highly immersive audiovisual universes. His work has been shown in various contexts around the world. In 2020, he was awarded the Japan Media Arts Festival New Face Award for his audiovisual fulldome performance Latent Space that was created during a residency at the Société des arts technologiques (SAT)  in Montréal. In 2024, he opened his large-scale solo exhibition SCREEN—SPACE in Krems, Austria.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw:
本名馬里安．埃斯爾，定居於維也納的音像藝術家，擅長藉由表演與裝置作品，探索聲音與影像之間的相互關係，透過演算法生成之影像，在流暢、有機的紋理和僵硬的結構之間擺盪。近年來，持續專注於聲音、影像、光影與空間的關係，創造極具沉浸感的音像宇宙。

2020年，他在加拿大SAT科技藝術中心駐村期間創作的穹形音像表演作品《Latent Space》，榮獲日本文化廳媒體藝術祭（Japan Media Arts Festival）的新人獎；2024年，在奧地利克雷姆斯舉辦了大型個展「SCREEN—SPACE」。

contributors.name: Tim WEI
contributors.introduction: A Taiwanese media artist studying at the Institute of Advanced Media Arts and Sciences (IAMAS). Works have been exhibited at the National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts and MoCA Taipei. Also serves technical roles in immersive art spaces and performances across Taiwan. Primarily working with moving images, audiovisuals, and electronic installations, the practice explores relationships in translating text into images, including distortion, mutual referencing, and the mapping of various linear narratives.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 臺灣的媒體藝術家，現就讀於情報科學藝術學院（IAMAS）。作品曾於國立臺灣美術館、台北當代藝術館展出，並在台灣各地的沉浸式藝術空間與演出中擔任技術角色。作品大部分為動態影像、音像和電子裝置。探索文本轉換為影像時的各種關係，包含失真、互相指涉、不同線性敘事對應等。

contributors.name: Kivi
contributors.introduction:
Paiwan singer-songwriter Kivi comes from Bayao Village in Manzhou Township, Pingtung, Taiwan. With a fashion-forward presence reminiscent of FKA twigs, she leaves a strong impression both visually and vocally. The first time you hear her sing, it is hard not to be struck by the powerful energy contained within her petite frame.
Kivi’s soft and lyrical voice evokes shared memories and emotional resonance across generations of Indigenous communities—like a gentle reminder or blessing from an elder. This quality has earned her a devoted following, with several of her YouTube videos surpassing one million views.In June 2022, she released her debut Indigenous-language album Padiyudr, which was nominated for three major awards at the 34th Golden Melody Awards: Best Indigenous Language Album, Best Indigenous Language Singer, and Album of the Year.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 排灣族唱作人 kivi 來自屏東滿洲鄉八瑤部落，外型宛如 FKA Twigs 般時尚。初聽見她的聲音，也總讓人驚艷她瘦小身軀裡蘊含的巨大能量。kivi 輕柔婉轉的歌聲勾勒出不同世代原住民群體生活的記憶共感，像是老人家溫柔的叮嚀或祝福。這樣的特質讓她擁有眾多粉絲及數支 YouTube 破百萬點閱影片。2022年6月發行第一張族語創作專輯《 分水嶺 Padiyudr 》，入圍第 34 屆金曲獎 最佳原住民專輯、最佳原住民歌手、年度專輯等三大獎。

contributors.name: LIM Giong
contributors.introduction: Musicworker. Mainly produces music scores of fiction films and documentaries and has also worked on scores of shorts, commercials, dance performances, light installations and VR; and has tried to collaborate and exchange ideas with artists from various fields. He is exploring abstract electronic tones and experimental and ambient music creation – sailing through reality and imagination, existence and dreams, the way it is to view our life.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 音樂工作者，主要製作電影和紀錄片配樂，也曾參與短片、廣告、舞蹈、燈光裝置藝術、VR等配樂，嘗試與各領域的藝術家交流合作，近期探索抽象電子聲響與實驗及環境音樂創作，虛實幻影，戲夢人生，應作如是觀。

contributors.name: Mr. Skin
contributors.introduction: Mr. Skin is not only a champion in various music competitions but also the founder of the renowned nightclub Cocco & Co. in Kaohsiung, often hailed as the city’s liveliest club. Additionally, he serves as the music director for the famous MUSE nightclub. Constantly creating, performing, and hosting parties, Mr. Skin plays multiple roles across vibrant venues. In response to nightclubs’ restrictions on Mandarin songs, he founded Mandarin Homework, a project aimed at rekindling pride and identity of the mother tongue.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 賴皮 MR.SKIN不僅是各種音樂競賽的常勝軍，更是有「高雄最嗨夜店」之稱Cocco & Co.的創辦人，以及知名夜店MUSE的音樂總監。閒不下來的賴皮平時除了創作和演出，更經常舉辦派對活動，在眾多五光十色的場域中擔任多重角色。賴皮為了抗爭夜店不能放中文歌曲這件事，於是創立了「國語作業簿」，「國語作業簿是想喚醒大家對於自己語言的認同。」​​。

contributors.name: Jie LIOU
contributors.introduction: A Taiwanese visual director, new media artist, and founder of FPA (Floating Point Art). Specializing in visual concept design and motion graphics, he merges sound and image to explore the philosophical and symbolic dimensions of audiovisual expression.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 新媒體藝術家、導演，以及浮點設計的創辦人。他的創作遊走於藝術與商案之間，透過精準的系統邏輯與深刻的敘事，探討時間、感知及空間的本質。他擅長以科技為媒介，將創意設計轉化為富含深度與沉浸感的視覺體驗。

contributors.introduction:
A Taiwanese media artist, a Lecturer at National Tsing Hua University, specializes in computer music, audiovisual performances, and installation art. His works have been featured at various art festivals and exhibitions in festivals across Asia, Europe, and North America.

藝術家，同時為國立清華大學藝術學院學士班專任講師，創作為電腦音樂、音像演出、媒體裝置。作品發表於臺灣雙年展、臺灣國際光影藝術節、臺灣燈會、月津港燈節、台北白晝之夜等活動，演出、共製及藝術駐村計劃於亞洲、歐洲和北美地區的聯展和藝術節中展出。

以聲音為創作思考中心的藝術工作者。2015、2016入選「數位藝術獎」、參與《Render Ghost》團隊拿下「數位藝術表演獎首獎」。2017巴賽隆納《Transonic》演出，兩廳院年度製作《全然的愛與真實》擔任聲音設計，林強擔任藝術總監的兩廳院30週年《眾聲之所》的演出。2018獲選韓國駐村計畫。2019年獲得文化部合作甄選至紐約藝術機構「三角藝術協會」駐村。2019年六月代表C-LAB赴龐畢度中心IRCAM實驗室參訪交流，於台北白晝之夜發表聲音演出作品。2020年受邀台中歌劇製作《無光風景》。並於新媒體藝術策劃團隊「噪咖事務所」擔任音樂統籌。

contributors.name: barbe_generative_diary
contributors.introduction: barbe_generative_diary records the sounds embedded in phenomena around the world through field recording. Using environmental sounds and vibration data as source material, it reconstructs invisible sonic landscapes through program code and drawing machines. Through this ongoing process, it explores new possibilities for creative expression.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 透過田野錄音，採集並紀錄嵌入於世界各地現象中的聲音。以環境聲響與振動數據為素材，藉由程式碼與繪圖裝置，重構出肉眼不可見的聲音地景。透過持續進行的實踐過程，進一步探索藝術創作表達的新可能性。

contributors.name: KIM Tae yeon
contributors.introduction: KIM Tae yeon's work connects time and memory through sound, exploring traces of existence within a reconstructed reality. By utilizing recorded and transformed sounds, his work summons unfading memories into the present, navigating the space between technological evolution and the lingering resonance of the senses.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 金泰淵以聲音為主要創作媒介，透過時間與記憶的連結，在重構的現實中探索存在的痕跡。在科技演進與感官共鳴之間，他藉由被記錄與轉化的聲音，將不朽的記憶喚回當下。

contributors.name: Root LEE
contributors.introduction:
Root LEE explores the dialogue between traditional East Asian ink-wash and digital media.
His work pushes the boundaries of Korean calligraphy, reimagining it as a series of site-specific experiments. In a process that is both technical and deeply physical, Root uses real-time camera tracking to capture the light-trails of his body’s movement, transforming them into calligraphic forms. He finds his subject matter in the world’s most delicate details—anything that flickers or trembles becomes a poetic script in his hands. Currently, Root is focused on "virtual placelessness," exploring the aesthetic significance of records as they fade within the rapid flux of modern technology.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 致力於探索東亞傳統水墨與數位媒體的對話，李根耀透過場域特定實驗，重新定義韓國傳統書藝的邊界。其創作擅長運用技術與身體，藉由即時影像追蹤，將身體律動產生的光跡轉化為書寫；對他而言，世間閃爍與顫動的萬物皆為詩意主題。近年來，李根耀聚焦於「虛擬場域性」，在技術疾速異化的浪潮中，探尋消逝紀錄所蘊含的美學意義。

contributors.name: Jimmy YU
contributors.introduction: Jimmy Yu (b. 1998, Seoul) holds a dual degree in Software Engineering and Performing Arts and is currently pursuing a Master’s in Multimedia at the Korea National University of Arts (K-ARTS). In July 2024, she debuted with a 10-minute twerking performance that interrogated the physicality of women and the paradoxes of their existence. Her signature XR trilogy, Downfall of the Virtual Human, has been showcased at prominent international venues including ISEA and DOK Leipzig. Spanning a diverse range of media, her artistic practice delves into the anthropomorphism of technology and re-envisions the presence of the female body.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 1998 年生於首爾，具備軟體工程與表演藝術雙學位背景，目前就讀於韓國藝術綜合大學多媒體藝術研究所。2024 年 7 月，她以一場時長 10 分鐘的電臀舞（twerking）表演首度亮相，該作主要探討女性身體性及其矛盾的存有狀態。其代表性 XR 三部曲《虛擬人類的殞落》曾受邀於 ISEA 與 DOK Leipzig 等國際平台展出。她的藝術實踐跨越多元媒介，深入剖析技術的人格化現象，並重新構思女性身體的呈現語境。

contributors.name: Damonxart (Damon HSIEH)
contributors.introduction: Damonxart (Damon HSIEH) is a Taiwan-based digital light artist whose practice explores the relationship between light, color, and spatial perception. Inspired by natural phenomena such as skies, planetary rings, auroras, and optical effects, his works construct immersive visual environments through dynamic gradients and flowing trajectories of light. By combining digital techniques with optical media, Damonxart transforms abstract color research into spatial experiences that evoke a sense of cosmic scale and movement. His works often feature circular structures, luminous flows, and layered color fields that reflect the interaction between time, space, and perception.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 臺灣數位光影藝術家，長期探索光、色彩與空間感知之間的關係。其創作靈感多來自天空、行星、極光與自然光學現象，透過漸層色彩與動態光流構築出具有宇宙感的視覺場域。謝鎮璘擅長運用數位技術與光學媒材，將抽象的色彩研究轉化為沉浸式的空間經驗，作品經常以光的軌跡、環形結構與流動色彩呈現時間與空間的交錯關係。近年亦持續探索數位與實體裝置之間的融合，透過光與色彩重新思考人與空間的感知方式。

contributors.name: Lynn TOMLINSON
contributors.introduction: Lynn TOMLINSON is an award-winning animator and media artist known for her tactile, painterly approach to stop-motion animation. Working with oil-based clay, she crafts moving landscapes that pulse with texture and emotion. Her films often explore ecological interconnection and transformation through hand-made imagery and sound. Mountain Nocturne continues her investigation of natural cycles and the more-than-human world, expanding her practice into the immersive format of fulldome animation. Tomlinson’s work has been exhibited internationally in festivals, museums, and planetariums, and she teaches animation at Towson University in Maryland.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 琳恩．湯琳森為一屢獲殊榮的動畫師與媒體藝術家，以其具觸感、如繪畫般的逐格動畫手法聞名。她運用油性黏土創作出充滿質感與情感脈動的動態景觀，作品經常透過手工影像與聲音探討生態互動與轉化的議題。《山之夜曲》延續她對自然循環與非人世界的探索，並將創作拓展至沉浸式穹頂動畫的形式。湯琳森的作品曾在國際影展、博物館及天文館展出，現於美國馬里蘭州陶森大學教授動畫。

contributors.name: LIU Tung-Yu
contributors.introduction:
WHEREISCHAPPIE (LIU Tung-Yu) is an audiovisual artist and project manager whose practice spans street dance, performing arts, and media arts. Working across creation, production, and system design, he moves between these fields through multiple intersecting roles. His work focuses on the real-time generation of sound and algorithmic visuals, treating code and self-built interfaces as performative materials. Through structured improvisation, he constructs dynamic audiovisual systems operating between control and randomness. His works reflect observations of subcultural environments alongside a sense of childlike playfulness. His performances have been presented at digital art festivals and experimental sound scenes. He currently serves as Executive Director of the audiovisual group Fluid Noise and as Adjunct Lecturer in the Department of New Media Art at Taipei National University of the Arts.

He has been researching on the creation of live coding/just in time programming since 2020. His works are soft and gentle, sometimes with childlike tones in the hope that live coding will be more accessible for audiences. (For more information about him, please go to: https://whereischappie.weebly.com.)
contributors.introduction_zh_tw:
音像藝術家及專案經理。經歷包含街舞、表演藝術與媒體藝術，以創作、製作與系統設計等多重角色穿梭其中。其創作以聲音與演算視覺的即時生成，將程式碼與自製介面視為表演材料，常以結構即興方式演出，在控制與隨機之間構築動態音像；作品風格帶有社群觀察與童趣語彙，演出見於數位藝術節與實驗聲響等場景。現任音像推廣團體「噪流」執行總監，及臺北藝術大學新媒體藝術學系兼任講師。
