專案協調者與音像創作者，以製作、技術、創作多重角色穿梭於街舞、劇場、新媒體等領域。2020年起開始「Live coding 即時程式撰寫」創作研究，作品風格柔和、時常帶有童趣，期望讓觀眾輕鬆地欣賞程式創作。（更多：https://whereischappie.weebly.com）

contributors.name: Warrick TSAI
contributors.introduction: Based on the background of the Information industry to the realm of New Media Arts, graduated from TNUA New Media Art Department, co-founded the “Winnowork” art studio, current project principal of the FUTURE VISION LAB project. Dedicated in analog and digital translation, specialized in integration of hard/soft wares, system design, computing generating, audio and lighting devices etc. Exploring the various possibilities between different techniques and materials.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 從資訊背景跨入新媒體藝術領域，畢業於臺北藝術大學新媒體藝術研究所，共同創辦沃手工作藝術團隊，現為 C-LAB 科技媒體實驗平台FUTURE VISION LAB計畫主持人。致力於將類比與數位進行轉譯演算。擅長軟硬體整合、系統設計、演算生成、聲音裝置與燈光裝置等，長期專注以各種技術形式來探索不同媒材之間的可能性。

contributors.name: Yude LIN
contributors.introduction:
Sound designer and composer working across theatre, short film, and multidisciplinary media. Recent projects include On My Way to Buy Eggs by Hung Chien-Tsang × Rock Rock Crafting at the 2025 Taipei Children’s Arts Festival; Ghostopia by Approaching Theatre; and Islands, a choreography work by WANG Yeu-Kwn, presented at the 2024 Artquake in Autumn Festival.
He also served as sound designer for Apostating Time by Approaching Theatre × Gang-a Tsui Theater, which received the Taishin Arts Award Grand Prize and the Jury’s Choice Award at the Golden Melody Awards for Traditional Arts and Music.Performance highlights include the TPAC × JPG Lab project Before Attack After Release. His experimental film music and exhibition credits extend to Fangas Nayaw’s La XXX Punk II: Betel Nut Green; A Call of All Beings at the Taichung Museum of Art with Approaching Theatre's From Y to X; and DRIFT IN TIME by ULTRACOMBOS × Cicada.tw, presented at the C-LAB Sound Festival: DIVERSONICS.
Since 2023, he has been actively engaged in Live Coding music, co-hosting workshops initiated through the C-LAB CREATORS “Live Coding Research and Promotion Project,” and participating in educational outreach programs with the National Taichung Theater.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 劇場音樂設計，展覽、影像聲音設計與配樂。近期參與製作：2025臺北兒童藝術節 洪健藏X晃晃跨幅町《小魚散步》、 窮劇場《暗夜．腹語．鬼托邦》及王宇光《人之島》音樂設計、窮劇場x江之翠劇場 《感謝公主》聲響設計、朱宗慶打擊樂團「JPG擊樂實驗室」《一剎》演出。影像配樂與展覽聲音設計 Fangas Nayaw《La XXX Punk II: Betel Nut Green》、臺中市立美術館《萬物的邀約》(窮劇場《from Y to X》)、C-LAB 聲響藝術節 (叁式xCicada樂團《DRIFT IN TIME》)。2023 年 C-LAB CREATORS《Live Coding 研究推廣計畫》開始即時編碼音樂（Live Coding）教學推廣與相關演出，曾參與王道銀行教育基金會《形塑空響：編織中的開放空間》共演、《極微輸入：演算音像集》演出、臺中國家歌劇院藝術進校、藝術生活科學中心「音樂 Live Coding」研習等活動。

collectives.name: FPA (Floating Point Art)
collectives.description: FPA is a creative team bridging art, design, and technology, specializing in digital experiences and immersive storytelling. Using contemporary visual language and new media, we explore the "middle ground" between the binary of 0s and 1s—where rational structure meets emotional flow. Through reorganization and experimentation, we integrate visuals, interaction, sound, and space into cohesive experiences. Our goal is to establish a deeper, more human language for the digital age, creating works that are felt, experienced, and deeply connected to people.
collectives.description_zh_tw: 一個跨足藝術、設計與科技的創意團隊，專注於數位體驗與沉浸式敘事。我們以當代視覺語言與新媒材，在 0 與 1 的數位基礎上，探索理性結構與感性流動之間的中間地帶。透過對形式的重組與實驗，我們將視覺、互動、聲音與空間組構成完整的體驗，為當代數位世界建立更具深度、溫度且能與人產生連結的感知語言。

collectives.name: AINO X Yunyoung JANG
collectives.description: AINO X Yunyoung JANG is a media art duo formed to explore the organic connections between the inner human world and the external ecological environment through technology. By fusing AINO’s systematization of ‘emotion-sensation’ and Jang’s exploration of ‘relational-ecological networks,’ they create immersive, multi-sensory experiences. AINO (Sound Art) builds systems that translate immaterial emotions into material experiences, while Yunyoung JANG (Visual Art) envisions future ecosystems where humans, animals, and AI coexist. Their collaboration seeks to dissolve the dichotomies between subject and world, proposing a post-humanocentric perspective.
collectives.description_zh_tw: 藝術家雙人組 AINO X Yunyoung JANG 致力於透過科技探索人類內在世界與外部生態環境之間的有機連結。結合 AINO 對「情感-感覺」的系統化研究與 Yunyoung 對「關係-生態網絡」的探索，他們的作品試圖消解主體與世界之間的二元對立。聲音藝術家 AINO 建構能將非物質情感轉化為物質感官體驗的系統，而影像藝術家 Yunyoung JANG 則構想人類、動物與 AI 共存的未來生態系。他們的創作欲打破「主體」與「世界」的二分法，企圖提出一種後人類中心的觀點。

collectives.name: YAO Jui-Chung × Yi KUO × Meuko Meuko
collectives.name_zh_tw: 姚瑞中 X 郭一 X Meuko! Meuko!
collectives.display_name: YAO Jui-Chung × Yi KUO × Meuko Meuko
collectives.description: The Mount Ecstasy project was initiated by contemporary artist YAO Jui-Chung, bringing his long-term observations on the "absurdity" of the human condition and the visual lexicon of "desire spectacles" found in Taiwanese folk religion into the digital realm. Serving as the original creator and concept director, YAO leads the narrative axis with his unique "Cold Reality" aesthetics, exploring the intertwining of karma and history. Visual production is led by director Yi KUO, NONTECH, and XTRUX, who reconstruct contemporary mythical rituals within a virtualized world. Experimental electronic musician Meuko Meuko infuses the work with profound sensory reflection through spiritual breakbeats and noise. Together, the team transforms painterly whimsy into an audiovisual revelry that merges technological hallucinations with historical memory.
collectives.description_zh_tw: 「虛迷山」計畫由當代藝術家姚瑞中發起，將其對人類處境「荒謬性」的長期觀察，以及台灣民間宗教中「欲力奇觀」的視覺語彙帶入數位領域。姚瑞中以其獨特的「冷現實」美學擔任原作與概念指導，引領整場創作的敘事軸心，探討業力與歷史的交織。影像導演郭一、NONTECH和XTRUX負責視覺製作，在虛擬化世界中重建當代神話儀式；實驗電音創作者Meuko Meuko則透過具靈性的碎拍與噪音，為作品注入深沉的感官思考。團隊共同將繪畫中的奇想轉化，建構出一場融合科技幻覺與歷史記憶的視聽狂歡。

collectives.name: Telling Tent
collectives.description: A children’s theatre with the concept of no boundaries, Telling Tent is a new experience of combining children’s arts and interactive technologies. They cooperate with young Taiwanese artists to create original animations. Stories are introduced by storytellers and audiences are surrounded with a hemispherical screen. There are sounds, scents, and a vibrating floor to make the audience feel they are on the scene. Marvellous animations with meaningful storylines combine with interactive technologies to offer you a whole new theatrical experience. It is a new way of performance.
collectives.description_zh_tw: 一個跨越邊境為創作概念的親子劇場，針對兒童藝術及科技互動發展創新體驗，結合臺灣年輕藝術家合作發展原創動畫，以包圍觀眾的沉浸式動畫為演出主軸，由劇場說書人引領觀眾們進入故事，藉由模擬情境配合劇場聲光等數位媒體裝置，營造一個完全身歷其境、充滿豐富想像的創新劇場互動體驗。

collectives.name: Dimension Plus
collectives.description: A new media art collective based in Taiwan and Hong Kong, exploring the relationship between art and science through cross-disciplinary experiments. Their works mix old and new media to address social, cultural, and ethical issues. By combining traditional and contemporary mediums, they aim to reflect on the impact of technology while pushing creative boundaries. Notable awards include the Best Design of the Year of Taiwan Golden Pin Design Award, Tokyo TDC, Asia Digital Arts Awards Japan and Gold Award of Design for Asia Award Hong Kong, German Design Award 2018 etc.
collectives.description_zh_tw: 臺港新媒體藝術創作團隊，專注藝術創作與科技媒體，擅長應用新媒體結合空間與跨領域的創作。​​2018 澳門設計雙年展 - 全場金獎 Macau Design Biennial - Gold Award - "Straw in the wind"、2018 亞洲具影響力設計獎 - 金獎 Hong Kong DFA Design for Asia Award - Gold Award 、2018 台灣金點設計獎 - 年度最佳設計 Taiwan Golden Pin Design Award - 2018 Best Design、2018 德國設計獎 German design award 金獎。

collectives.name: Hello Edo!
collectives.description: A creative collective deeply fascinated by AI-generated imagery. The members come from across Asia, passionate about using artificial intelligence for visual storytelling, drawing inspiration from art, culture, machinery, and futuristic visions of cyborg worlds. Their works have been featured in prominent exhibitions, including Modern Times and New Century Ukiyo-e at NTT Arts NOVA (National Taichung Theater, 2025), 2024 Hello, Human! exhibition, 2024 TTXC《G.A.M.E.》Culture Stew in Finland and Hong Kong, Microwave International New Media Arts Festival (Hong Kong, 2023)
collectives.description_zh_tw: 一個對於AI人工智能圖像生產技術深感興趣的創作團體，團員來自亞洲各地，熱衷於AI人工智能的影像創作，喜愛藝術、文化、機械、賽博格等未來想像的景致。 作品曾於2025 臺中國家歌劇院 Arts NOVA 「摩登時代」、「新世紀浮世繪」、2024「你好，人類」、台灣文化科技大會主題展「G.A.M.E.」、「文化燉」芬蘭站及香港站、2023「香港微波新媒體國際藝術節」展出。

collectives.name: Hello World
collectives.description: An Asia-based new media production company specializing in curating, producing, and promoting innovative works and artists with the goal of building an international platform for future art. Renowned for its expertise in international crossover collaborations, Hello World brings together leading Asian curators and producers in the field of technological art. In addition to representing artists, Hello World curates immersive exhibitions and fosters interdisciplinary collaborations at major international venues such as SXSW, MUTEK, MOCA Taipei, National Taichung Theater, National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts, and West Kowloon Cultural District.
collectives.description_zh_tw: 2023年正式成軍的「初未來」，集結亞洲優秀科技藝術策展人及製作人，以未來藝術生產與科技藝術展覽之專業視野，協助新銳獨立藝術家推展國際跨域整合製作。製作經驗包括：2025​​ 臺中國家歌劇院 Arts NOVA 「摩登時代」、「新世紀浮世繪」、「靈魂」、SXSW台灣館「VS AI街頭對戰」、2024「VS AI街頭對戰」世界大賽及國際展出、「你好，人類」、台灣文化科技大會主題「G.A.M.E.」、「GIGABYTE AI 新紀元，人類  X 藝術 X 科技特展」等。

collectives.name: PHOSPHEN
collectives.description: PHOSPHEN is a creator of content and a designer of virtual reality technologies and immersive environments. At its core, its purpose is to craft unique experiences through existing immersive technologies… or those yet to be invented. Whether through interactivity, sensory engagement, or immersive audiovisual design, its ongoing pursuit is to create powerful emotional connections that audiences will remember for a long time.
collectives.description_zh_tw: PHOSPHEN 是一家內容創作公司，致力於設計虛擬實境技術與沉浸式環境。核心宗旨在於透過現有或尚未被發明的沉浸式技術，打造獨一無二的體驗。無論是透過交互作用、感官參與或是沉浸式影音設計，其不斷追求的是創造出能讓觀眾長久銘記的強大情感連結。

collectives.name: Interdisciplinary Program of Technology and Art, National Tsing Hua University
collectives.name_zh_tw: 國立清華大學藝術學院學士班 / 科藝所
collectives.display_name: Interdisciplinary Program of Technology and Art, National Tsing Hua University
collectives.description: "Techno-Art" is a new form of contemporary art and an important trend in international art development. Established in 2018 at the National Tsing Hua University's College of Arts, it views the integration of technology and art as a professional field, aiming to cultivate future professionals in techno-art through cross-disciplinary creation and research.
collectives.description_zh_tw: 「科技藝術（Techno-Art）」是當代藝術的新形式創作也是國際藝術發展的重要趨勢，清大藝術學院自107學年成立，把「科技」與「藝術」結合視為「專業領域」，培育未來科技藝術跨域之專業創作與研究人才。

collectives.name: The Department of New Media Art of Taipei National University of the Arts
collectives.name_zh_tw: 國立臺北藝術大學新媒體藝術學系
collectives.display_name: The Department of New Media Art of Taipei National University of the Arts
collectives.description: The Department of New Media Art of Taipei National University of the Arts is the first department of its kind in the country. It breaks through the conventional boundaries of humanities and the arts to integrate cutting-edge technology and serves as an important promoter of the integration of digital technology and art to cultivate forward-looking creative talent in future art domains such as technology, images, and transdisciplinary works.
collectives.description_zh_tw: 為全國首創，是一跨越人文藝術領域與尖端科技結合的未來學門。作為推動數位科技與藝術整合的重要推手，培育前瞻性的「新媒體科技」、「新媒體影像」與「新媒體跨域」等藝術創意人才。

collectives.name: ​​The Department of Interaction Design of National Taipei University of Technology
collectives.display_name: ​​The Department of Interaction Design of National Taipei University of Technology
collectives.description: The department's vision is to meet the current and future manpower needs of industries in digital content, cultural and creative industries, information and communications technology (ICT), animation and gaming, mobile application services, Internet of Things (IoT), and social media, while nurturing students with forward-thinking, interdisciplinary, and cross-sector critical capabilities. The establishment of the Department of Interaction Design aligns with national industrial development needs, providing talent cultivation and training to meet market demands. It also fosters internationalized educational perspectives, equipping a new generation of designers with the essential knowledge and skills for the future.
collectives.description_zh_tw: 本系之願景為在配合現階段與未來國內外產業的人力需求為願景，於數位內容、文化創意、資通訊技術(ICT)、動畫遊戲、行動應用服務、物聯網(IoT)、社群媒體…等產業，培育學生具有前瞻性、跨產業、跨領域的關鍵能力。互動設計系的設置不僅符合國家未來產業發展的需求，提供所需人才的培養與訓練，更持續接軌與拓展國際化教育發展的視野，培育新一代設計師所應具備之本質學能。

contributors.name: Jie LIOU
contributors.introduction: A Taiwanese visual director, new media artist, and founder of FPA (Floating Point Art). Specializing in visual concept design and motion graphics, he merges sound and image to explore the philosophical and symbolic dimensions of audiovisual expression.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 新媒體藝術家、導演，以及浮點設計的創辦人。他的創作遊走於藝術與商案之間，透過精準的系統邏輯與深刻的敘事，探討時間、感知及空間的本質。他擅長以科技為媒介，將創意設計轉化為富含深度與沉浸感的視覺體驗。

contributors.name: WU Ping-Sheng
contributors.introduction:
A Taiwanese media artist, a Lecturer at National Tsing Hua University, specializes in computer music, audiovisual performances, and installation art. His works have been featured at various art festivals and exhibitions in festivals across Asia, Europe, and North America.

--- import from creators data (revise pls.) ---

As a sound artist, Ping Seng was nominated for the Digital Art Awards Taipei in 2015 and 2016. He was also a member of the production team of Render Ghost, the first prize-winner of the 6th Digital Art Performance Awards. His work Transonic was presented in Barcelona, Spain in 2017. He also served as the sound designer for the performance Unconditional Love and Fact at the National Theater & Concert Hall, and participated in the production of Electric Indigo, a special program celebrating the 30th anniversary of the National Theater & Concert Hall with LIM Giong as the artistic director. He worked as an artist-in-residence in Korea (2018) and New York (2019 at the Triangle Arts Association), visited the Centre Pompidouon’s IRCAM on behalf of the C-LAB in June 2019, and presented his sound performance at the Nuit Blanche Taipei. In 2020, he took part in the production of The Scenery of Little Light at the invitation of the National Taichung Theater, and serves as the music and sound director for noiseKitchen, a team focusing on new media art.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw:
藝術家，同時為國立清華大學藝術學院學士班專任講師，創作為電腦音樂、音像演出、媒體裝置。作品發表於臺灣雙年展、臺灣國際光影藝術節、臺灣燈會、月津港燈節、台北白晝之夜等活動，演出、共製及藝術駐村計劃於亞洲、歐洲和北美地區的聯展和藝術節中展出。

--- import from creators data (revise pls.) ---

以聲音為創作思考中心的藝術工作者。2015、2016入選「數位藝術獎」、參與《Render Ghost》團隊拿下「數位藝術表演獎首獎」。2017巴賽隆納《Transonic》演出，兩廳院年度製作《全然的愛與真實》擔任聲音設計，林強擔任藝術總監的兩廳院30週年《眾聲之所》的演出。2018獲選韓國駐村計畫。2019年獲得文化部合作甄選至紐約藝術機構「三角藝術協會」駐村。2019年六月代表C-LAB赴龐畢度中心IRCAM實驗室參訪交流，於台北白晝之夜發表聲音演出作品。2020年受邀台中歌劇製作《無光風景》。並於新媒體藝術策劃團隊「噪咖事務所」擔任音樂統籌。

contributors.name: Tim WEI
contributors.introduction: A Taiwanese media artist studying at the Institute of Advanced Media Arts and Sciences (IAMAS). Works have been exhibited at the National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts and MoCA Taipei. Also serves technical roles in immersive art spaces and performances across Taiwan. Primarily working with moving images, audiovisuals, and electronic installations, the practice explores relationships in translating text into images, including distortion, mutual referencing, and the mapping of various linear narratives.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 臺灣的媒體藝術家，現就讀於情報科學藝術學院（IAMAS）。作品曾於國立臺灣美術館、台北當代藝術館展出，並在台灣各地的沉浸式藝術空間與演出中擔任技術角色。作品大部分為動態影像、音像和電子裝置。探索文本轉換為影像時的各種關係，包含失真、互相指涉、不同線性敘事對應等。

contributors.name: barbe_generative_diary
contributors.introduction: barbe_generative_diary records the sounds embedded in phenomena around the world through field recording. Using environmental sounds and vibration data as source material, it reconstructs invisible sonic landscapes through program code and drawing machines. Through this ongoing process, it explores new possibilities for creative expression.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 透過田野錄音，採集並紀錄嵌入於世界各地現象中的聲音。以環境聲響與振動數據為素材，藉由程式碼與繪圖裝置，重構出肉眼不可見的聲音地景。透過持續進行的實踐過程，進一步探索藝術創作表達的新可能性。

contributors.name: Sandrine DEUMIER
contributors.introduction: Sandrine DEUMIER is a multidisciplinary artist working in the fields of performance, poetry and video art, whose work investigates post-futurist themes through the development of aesthetic forms related to digital imaginaries. Passionate about digital storytelling, immersive artistic experiences, ecological concerns and speculative futures, her work focuses on imagining new ways of inhabiting the world using new technologies from an animist perspective.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 桑德琳．德米耶是一位跨領域藝術家，從事表演、詩歌和錄像藝術，作品透過數位想像的美學形式，研究後未來主義主題。通過互動敘事進行故事講述，發展以生命想像為中心的詩意虛擬視覺作品。生態關懷和未來推演是她研究的核心。通過新媒體創作，從泛靈論觀點想像新世界的生存途徑，自然平衡優先於掠奪，積累並無限生長。

contributors.name: Ralph KILLHERTZ
contributors.introduction: Ralph KILLHERTZ is an experimental composer, sound artist and developer of new musical technologies. He has shared the world of musical creation with the recording. He holds a Master in Electroacoustic Composition in “CSKG-Centro Superior de Enseñanzas Musicales Katarina Gurska” in Madrid. Passionate about the sound and the perception that the human being has of him, his work as a composer is based on the search and the analysis and functioning of the mechanisms of the perception, as well as in the creation of strategies that allow to convert the attentive listening in a mechanism of composition.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 基爾赫茲是聲音藝術家，馬德里高等音樂教育中心碩士。他將音樂創作與錄音技術結合，對於聲音以及人類對其聲音的感知充滿熱情；他的作曲主要基於對感知機制的探索、分析與運作研究，並致力於開發特定策略，將「專注聆聽」轉化為作曲的驅動機制。

contributors.name: Kati KATONA
contributors.introduction: Kati KATONA is a new media artist based in Budapest, Hungary. Her practice explores the intersection of technology, perception, and space through generative art, interactive installations, and projection mapping. Drawing inspiration from natural forms, biomorphic structures, and algorithmic systems, she creates meditative visual environments that invite introspection and a sense of presence. Through her immersive works, she explores how digital media can transform spatial perception and blur the boundaries between the physical and virtual realms.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 來自匈牙利布達佩斯的新媒體藝術家，其創作透過生成藝術、互動裝置與光雕投影，探索科技、知覺與空間的交會。靈感來源包括自然形態、有機結構與演算法系統，她以此打造冥想般的視覺環境，邀請觀眾進入自我沉思並感受當下存在。透過沉浸式作品，凱蒂探討數位媒體如何改變空間感知，並模糊物理與虛擬之間的界線。

contributors.name: Kohui
contributors.introduction:
Kohui explores relationships shaped through sound, with a focus on the act of sensing it. Observing natural phenomena, forms, methods, and the structures of today’s technologies, he designs algorithms that generate relationships between the predictable and the unpredictable. He reconfigures these relationships to expand ways of sensing sound, building his perspective on nature, the human, and sound.
He has presented audiovisual performances in Korea and abroad, including at ACT Festival, WeSA Festival, Unfold X 2025, ISEA 2025, MUTEK Montreal, and in Tokyo. He has also participated in group exhibitions at the Seoul Museum of Art, the National Asia Culture Center, and Platform-L, among others. He was selected as a HYUNDAI ZER01NE Creator in 2022 and founded the artist collective TAKA in 2024. He has also served as an adjunct professor at the Korea National University of Arts.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw:
韓國音像藝術家，以前衛、獨特的創作風格聞名，作品融合影像、音樂與互動元素，探索數位虛擬與真實世界的邊界。其創作類型包含生成藝術，致力於研究音像藝術的本質及其可能性。
他曾在韓國國內外發表影音演出，包括 ACT 藝術節、WeSA 藝術節、Unfold X 2025、ISEA 2025、蒙特婁及東京 MUTEK 藝術節。他也曾參與首爾市立美術館、國立亞洲文化殿堂（ACC）及 Platform-L 等地的聯展。他於 2022 年入選為現代汽車（HYUNDAI）ZER01NE 創作者，並於 2024 年創立藝術團體 TAKA。此外，他亦曾擔任韓國藝術綜合大學（K-ARTS）的兼任教授。

contributors.name: MONOCOLOR
contributors.introduction: MONOCOLOR alias Marian Essl is a Vienna based audiovisual artist. He explores the interrelations between sound and image in both performance-based and installation-based works. His fully generative, algorithmically created imagery oscillates between fluid, organic textures and rigid structures. He focuses on the relation between sound, image, light and space, aiming to create highly immersive audiovisual universes. His work has been shown in various contexts around the world. In 2020, he was awarded the Japan Media Arts Festival New Face Award for his audiovisual fulldome performance Latent Space that was created during a residency at the Société des arts technologiques (SAT)  in Montréal. In 2024, he opened his large-scale solo exhibition SCREEN—SPACE in Krems, Austria.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw:
本名馬里安．埃斯爾，定居於維也納的音像藝術家，擅長藉由表演與裝置作品，探索聲音與影像之間的相互關係，透過演算法生成之影像，在流暢、有機的紋理和僵硬的結構之間擺盪。近年來，持續專注於聲音、影像、光影與空間的關係，創造極具沉浸感的音像宇宙。

2020年，他在加拿大SAT科技藝術中心駐村期間創作的穹形音像表演作品《Latent Space》，榮獲日本文化廳媒體藝術祭（Japan Media Arts Festival）的新人獎；2024年，在奧地利克雷姆斯舉辦了大型個展「SCREEN—SPACE」。

contributors.name: Kivi
contributors.introduction:
Paiwan singer-songwriter Kivi comes from Bayao Village in Manzhou Township, Pingtung, Taiwan. With a fashion-forward presence reminiscent of FKA twigs, she leaves a strong impression both visually and vocally. The first time you hear her sing, it is hard not to be struck by the powerful energy contained within her petite frame.
Kivi’s soft and lyrical voice evokes shared memories and emotional resonance across generations of Indigenous communities—like a gentle reminder or blessing from an elder. This quality has earned her a devoted following, with several of her YouTube videos surpassing one million views.In June 2022, she released her debut Indigenous-language album Padiyudr, which was nominated for three major awards at the 34th Golden Melody Awards: Best Indigenous Language Album, Best Indigenous Language Singer, and Album of the Year.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 排灣族唱作人 kivi 來自屏東滿洲鄉八瑤部落，外型宛如 FKA Twigs 般時尚。初聽見她的聲音，也總讓人驚艷她瘦小身軀裡蘊含的巨大能量。kivi 輕柔婉轉的歌聲勾勒出不同世代原住民群體生活的記憶共感，像是老人家溫柔的叮嚀或祝福。這樣的特質讓她擁有眾多粉絲及數支 YouTube 破百萬點閱影片。2022年6月發行第一張族語創作專輯《 分水嶺 Padiyudr 》，入圍第 34 屆金曲獎 最佳原住民專輯、最佳原住民歌手、年度專輯等三大獎。

contributors.name: Mr. Skin
contributors.introduction: Mr. Skin is not only a champion in various music competitions but also the founder of the renowned nightclub Cocco & Co. in Kaohsiung, often hailed as the city’s liveliest club. Additionally, he serves as the music director for the famous MUSE nightclub. Constantly creating, performing, and hosting parties, Mr. Skin plays multiple roles across vibrant venues. In response to nightclubs’ restrictions on Mandarin songs, he founded Mandarin Homework, a project aimed at rekindling pride and identity of the mother tongue.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 賴皮 MR.SKIN不僅是各種音樂競賽的常勝軍，更是有「高雄最嗨夜店」之稱Cocco & Co.的創辦人，以及知名夜店MUSE的音樂總監。閒不下來的賴皮平時除了創作和演出，更經常舉辦派對活動，在眾多五光十色的場域中擔任多重角色。賴皮為了抗爭夜店不能放中文歌曲這件事，於是創立了「國語作業簿」，「國語作業簿是想喚醒大家對於自己語言的認同。」​​。

contributors.name: LIM Giong
contributors.introduction: Musicworker. Mainly produces music scores of fiction films and documentaries and has also worked on scores of shorts, commercials, dance performances, light installations and VR; and has tried to collaborate and exchange ideas with artists from various fields. He is exploring abstract electronic tones and experimental and ambient music creation – sailing through reality and imagination, existence and dreams, the way it is to view our life.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 音樂工作者，主要製作電影和紀錄片配樂，也曾參與短片、廣告、舞蹈、燈光裝置藝術、VR等配樂，嘗試與各領域的藝術家交流合作，近期探索抽象電子聲響與實驗及環境音樂創作，虛實幻影，戲夢人生，應作如是觀。

contributors.name: Warrick TSAI
contributors.introduction: Based on the background of the Information industry to the realm of New Media Arts, graduated from TNUA New Media Art Department, co-founded the “Winnowork” art studio, current project principal of the FUTURE VISION LAB project. Dedicated in analog and digital translation, specialized in integration of hard/soft wares, system design, computing generating, audio and lighting devices etc. Exploring the various possibilities between different techniques and materials.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 從資訊背景跨入新媒體藝術領域，畢業於臺北藝術大學新媒體藝術研究所，共同創辦沃手工作藝術團隊，現為 C-LAB 科技媒體實驗平台FUTURE VISION LAB計畫主持人。致力於將類比與數位進行轉譯演算。擅長軟硬體整合、系統設計、演算生成、聲音裝置與燈光裝置等，長期專注以各種技術形式來探索不同媒材之間的可能性。

contributors.name: Root LEE
contributors.introduction:
Root LEE explores the dialogue between traditional East Asian ink-wash and digital media.
His work pushes the boundaries of Korean calligraphy, reimagining it as a series of site-specific experiments. In a process that is both technical and deeply physical, Root uses real-time camera tracking to capture the light-trails of his body’s movement, transforming them into calligraphic forms. He finds his subject matter in the world’s most delicate details—anything that flickers or trembles becomes a poetic script in his hands. Currently, Root is focused on "virtual placelessness," exploring the aesthetic significance of records as they fade within the rapid flux of modern technology.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 致力於探索東亞傳統水墨與數位媒體的對話，李根耀透過場域特定實驗，重新定義韓國傳統書藝的邊界。其創作擅長運用技術與身體，藉由即時影像追蹤，將身體律動產生的光跡轉化為書寫；對他而言，世間閃爍與顫動的萬物皆為詩意主題。近年來，李根耀聚焦於「虛擬場域性」，在技術疾速異化的浪潮中，探尋消逝紀錄所蘊含的美學意義。

contributors.name: Jimmy YU
contributors.introduction: Jimmy Yu (b. 1998, Seoul) holds a dual degree in Software Engineering and Performing Arts and is currently pursuing a Master’s in Multimedia at the Korea National University of Arts (K-ARTS). In July 2024, she debuted with a 10-minute twerking performance that interrogated the physicality of women and the paradoxes of their existence. Her signature XR trilogy, Downfall of the Virtual Human, has been showcased at prominent international venues including ISEA and DOK Leipzig. Spanning a diverse range of media, her artistic practice delves into the anthropomorphism of technology and re-envisions the presence of the female body.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 1998 年生於首爾，具備軟體工程與表演藝術雙學位背景，目前就讀於韓國藝術綜合大學多媒體藝術研究所。2024 年 7 月，她以一場時長 10 分鐘的電臀舞（twerking）表演首度亮相，該作主要探討女性身體性及其矛盾的存有狀態。其代表性 XR 三部曲《虛擬人類的殞落》曾受邀於 ISEA 與 DOK Leipzig 等國際平台展出。她的藝術實踐跨越多元媒介，深入剖析技術的人格化現象，並重新構思女性身體的呈現語境。

contributors.name: Lynn TOMLINSON
contributors.introduction: Lynn TOMLINSON is an award-winning animator and media artist known for her tactile, painterly approach to stop-motion animation. Working with oil-based clay, she crafts moving landscapes that pulse with texture and emotion. Her films often explore ecological interconnection and transformation through hand-made imagery and sound. Mountain Nocturne continues her investigation of natural cycles and the more-than-human world, expanding her practice into the immersive format of fulldome animation. Tomlinson’s work has been exhibited internationally in festivals, museums, and planetariums, and she teaches animation at Towson University in Maryland.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 琳恩．湯琳森為一屢獲殊榮的動畫師與媒體藝術家，以其具觸感、如繪畫般的逐格動畫手法聞名。她運用油性黏土創作出充滿質感與情感脈動的動態景觀，作品經常透過手工影像與聲音探討生態互動與轉化的議題。《山之夜曲》延續她對自然循環與非人世界的探索，並將創作拓展至沉浸式穹頂動畫的形式。湯琳森的作品曾在國際影展、博物館及天文館展出，現於美國馬里蘭州陶森大學教授動畫。

contributors.name: LIU Tung-Yu
contributors.introduction:
WHEREISCHAPPIE (LIU Tung-Yu) is an audiovisual artist and project manager whose practice spans street dance, performing arts, and media arts. Working across creation, production, and system design, he moves between these fields through multiple intersecting roles. His work focuses on the real-time generation of sound and algorithmic visuals, treating code and self-built interfaces as performative materials. Through structured improvisation, he constructs dynamic audiovisual systems operating between control and randomness. His works reflect observations of subcultural environments alongside a sense of childlike playfulness. His performances have been presented at digital art festivals and experimental sound scenes. He currently serves as Executive Director of the audiovisual group Fluid Noise and as Adjunct Lecturer in the Department of New Media Art at Taipei National University of the Arts.

contributors.introduction_zh_tw:
音像藝術家及專案經理。經歷包含街舞、表演藝術與媒體藝術，以創作、製作與系統設計等多重角色穿梭其中。其創作以聲音與演算視覺的即時生成，將程式碼與自製介面視為表演材料，常以結構即興方式演出，在控制與隨機之間構築動態音像；作品風格帶有社群觀察與童趣語彙，演出見於數位藝術節與實驗聲響等場景。現任音像推廣團體「噪流」執行總監，及臺北藝術大學新媒體藝術學系兼任講師。

專案協調者與音像創作者，以製作、技術、創作多重角色穿梭於街舞、劇場、新媒體等領域。2020年起開始「Live coding 即時程式撰寫」創作研究，作品風格柔和、時常帶有童趣，期望讓觀眾輕鬆地欣賞程式創作。（更多：https://whereischappie.weebly.com）

contributors.name: KIM Tae yeon
contributors.introduction: KIM Tae yeon's work connects time and memory through sound, exploring traces of existence within a reconstructed reality. By utilizing recorded and transformed sounds, his work summons unfading memories into the present, navigating the space between technological evolution and the lingering resonance of the senses.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 金泰淵以聲音為主要創作媒介，透過時間與記憶的連結，在重構的現實中探索存在的痕跡。在科技演進與感官共鳴之間，他藉由被記錄與轉化的聲音，將不朽的記憶喚回當下。

contributors.name: Damonxart (Damon HSIEH)
contributors.introduction: Damonxart (Damon HSIEH) is a Taiwan-based digital light artist whose practice explores the relationship between light, color, and spatial perception. Inspired by natural phenomena such as skies, planetary rings, auroras, and optical effects, his works construct immersive visual environments through dynamic gradients and flowing trajectories of light. By combining digital techniques with optical media, Damonxart transforms abstract color research into spatial experiences that evoke a sense of cosmic scale and movement. His works often feature circular structures, luminous flows, and layered color fields that reflect the interaction between time, space, and perception.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 臺灣數位光影藝術家，長期探索光、色彩與空間感知之間的關係。其創作靈感多來自天空、行星、極光與自然光學現象，透過漸層色彩與動態光流構築出具有宇宙感的視覺場域。謝鎮璘擅長運用數位技術與光學媒材，將抽象的色彩研究轉化為沉浸式的空間經驗，作品經常以光的軌跡、環形結構與流動色彩呈現時間與空間的交錯關係。近年亦持續探索數位與實體裝置之間的融合，透過光與色彩重新思考人與空間的感知方式。

contributors.name: Yude LIN
contributors.introduction:
Sound designer and composer working across theatre, short film, and multidisciplinary media. Recent projects include On My Way to Buy Eggs by Hung Chien-Tsang × Rock Rock Crafting at the 2025 Taipei Children’s Arts Festival; Ghostopia by Approaching Theatre; and Islands, a choreography work by WANG Yeu-Kwn, presented at the 2024 Artquake in Autumn Festival.
He also served as sound designer for Apostating Time by Approaching Theatre × Gang-a Tsui Theater, which received the Taishin Arts Award Grand Prize and the Jury’s Choice Award at the Golden Melody Awards for Traditional Arts and Music.Performance highlights include the TPAC × JPG Lab project Before Attack After Release. His experimental film music and exhibition credits extend to Fangas Nayaw’s La XXX Punk II: Betel Nut Green; A Call of All Beings at the Taichung Museum of Art with Approaching Theatre's From Y to X; and DRIFT IN TIME by ULTRACOMBOS × Cicada.tw, presented at the C-LAB Sound Festival: DIVERSONICS.
Since 2023, he has been actively engaged in Live Coding music, co-hosting workshops initiated through the C-LAB CREATORS “Live Coding Research and Promotion Project,” and participating in educational outreach programs with the National Taichung Theater.
contributors.introduction_zh_tw: 劇場音樂設計，展覽、影像聲音設計與配樂。近期參與製作：2025臺北兒童藝術節 洪健藏X晃晃跨幅町《小魚散步》、 窮劇場《暗夜．腹語．鬼托邦》及王宇光《人之島》音樂設計、窮劇場x江之翠劇場 《感謝公主》聲響設計、朱宗慶打擊樂團「JPG擊樂實驗室」《一剎》演出。影像配樂與展覽聲音設計 Fangas Nayaw《La XXX Punk II: Betel Nut Green》、臺中市立美術館《萬物的邀約》(窮劇場《from Y to X》)、C-LAB 聲響藝術節 (叁式xCicada樂團《DRIFT IN TIME》)。2023 年 C-LAB CREATORS《Live Coding 研究推廣計畫》開始即時編碼音樂（Live Coding）教學推廣與相關演出，曾參與王道銀行教育基金會《形塑空響：編織中的開放空間》共演、《極微輸入：演算音像集》演出、臺中國家歌劇院藝術進校、藝術生活科學中心「音樂 Live Coding」研習等活動。

collectives.name: FPA (Floating Point Art)
collectives.description: FPA is a creative team bridging art, design, and technology, specializing in digital experiences and immersive storytelling. Using contemporary visual language and new media, we explore the "middle ground" between the binary of 0s and 1s—where rational structure meets emotional flow. Through reorganization and experimentation, we integrate visuals, interaction, sound, and space into cohesive experiences. Our goal is to establish a deeper, more human language for the digital age, creating works that are felt, experienced, and deeply connected to people.
collectives.description_zh_tw: 一個跨足藝術、設計與科技的創意團隊，專注於數位體驗與沉浸式敘事。我們以當代視覺語言與新媒材，在 0 與 1 的數位基礎上，探索理性結構與感性流動之間的中間地帶。透過對形式的重組與實驗，我們將視覺、互動、聲音與空間組構成完整的體驗，為當代數位世界建立更具深度、溫度且能與人產生連結的感知語言。

collectives.name: AINO X Yunyoung JANG
collectives.description: AINO X Yunyoung JANG is a media art duo formed to explore the organic connections between the inner human world and the external ecological environment through technology. By fusing AINO’s systematization of ‘emotion-sensation’ and Jang’s exploration of ‘relational-ecological networks,’ they create immersive, multi-sensory experiences. AINO (Sound Art) builds systems that translate immaterial emotions into material experiences, while Yunyoung JANG (Visual Art) envisions future ecosystems where humans, animals, and AI coexist. Their collaboration seeks to dissolve the dichotomies between subject and world, proposing a post-humanocentric perspective.
collectives.description_zh_tw: 藝術家雙人組 AINO X Yunyoung JANG 致力於透過科技探索人類內在世界與外部生態環境之間的有機連結。結合 AINO 對「情感-感覺」的系統化研究與 Yunyoung 對「關係-生態網絡」的探索，他們的作品試圖消解主體與世界之間的二元對立。聲音藝術家 AINO 建構能將非物質情感轉化為物質感官體驗的系統，而影像藝術家 Yunyoung JANG 則構想人類、動物與 AI 共存的未來生態系。他們的創作欲打破「主體」與「世界」的二分法，企圖提出一種後人類中心的觀點。

collectives.name: Telling Tent
collectives.description: A children’s theatre with the concept of no boundaries, Telling Tent is a new experience of combining children’s arts and interactive technologies. They cooperate with young Taiwanese artists to create original animations. Stories are introduced by storytellers and audiences are surrounded with a hemispherical screen. There are sounds, scents, and a vibrating floor to make the audience feel they are on the scene. Marvellous animations with meaningful storylines combine with interactive technologies to offer you a whole new theatrical experience. It is a new way of performance.
collectives.description_zh_tw: 一個跨越邊境為創作概念的親子劇場，針對兒童藝術及科技互動發展創新體驗，結合臺灣年輕藝術家合作發展原創動畫，以包圍觀眾的沉浸式動畫為演出主軸，由劇場說書人引領觀眾們進入故事，藉由模擬情境配合劇場聲光等數位媒體裝置，營造一個完全身歷其境、充滿豐富想像的創新劇場互動體驗。

collectives.name: Hello World
collectives.description: An Asia-based new media production company specializing in curating, producing, and promoting innovative works and artists with the goal of building an international platform for future art. Renowned for its expertise in international crossover collaborations, Hello World brings together leading Asian curators and producers in the field of technological art. In addition to representing artists, Hello World curates immersive exhibitions and fosters interdisciplinary collaborations at major international venues such as SXSW, MUTEK, MOCA Taipei, National Taichung Theater, National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts, and West Kowloon Cultural District.
collectives.description_zh_tw: 2023年正式成軍的「初未來」，集結亞洲優秀科技藝術策展人及製作人，以未來藝術生產與科技藝術展覽之專業視野，協助新銳獨立藝術家推展國際跨域整合製作。製作經驗包括：2025​​ 臺中國家歌劇院 Arts NOVA 「摩登時代」、「新世紀浮世繪」、「靈魂」、SXSW台灣館「VS AI街頭對戰」、2024「VS AI街頭對戰」世界大賽及國際展出、「你好，人類」、台灣文化科技大會主題「G.A.M.E.」、「GIGABYTE AI 新紀元，人類  X 藝術 X 科技特展」等。

collectives.name: Dimension Plus
collectives.description: A new media art collective based in Taiwan and Hong Kong, exploring the relationship between art and science through cross-disciplinary experiments. Their works mix old and new media to address social, cultural, and ethical issues. By combining traditional and contemporary mediums, they aim to reflect on the impact of technology while pushing creative boundaries. Notable awards include the Best Design of the Year of Taiwan Golden Pin Design Award, Tokyo TDC, Asia Digital Arts Awards Japan and Gold Award of Design for Asia Award Hong Kong, German Design Award 2018 etc.
collectives.description_zh_tw: 臺港新媒體藝術創作團隊，專注藝術創作與科技媒體，擅長應用新媒體結合空間與跨領域的創作。​​2018 澳門設計雙年展 - 全場金獎 Macau Design Biennial - Gold Award - "Straw in the wind"、2018 亞洲具影響力設計獎 - 金獎 Hong Kong DFA Design for Asia Award - Gold Award 、2018 台灣金點設計獎 - 年度最佳設計 Taiwan Golden Pin Design Award - 2018 Best Design、2018 德國設計獎 German design award 金獎。

collectives.name: Hello Edo!
collectives.description: A creative collective deeply fascinated by AI-generated imagery. The members come from across Asia, passionate about using artificial intelligence for visual storytelling, drawing inspiration from art, culture, machinery, and futuristic visions of cyborg worlds. Their works have been featured in prominent exhibitions, including Modern Times and New Century Ukiyo-e at NTT Arts NOVA (National Taichung Theater, 2025), 2024 Hello, Human! exhibition, 2024 TTXC《G.A.M.E.》Culture Stew in Finland and Hong Kong, Microwave International New Media Arts Festival (Hong Kong, 2023)
collectives.description_zh_tw: 一個對於AI人工智能圖像生產技術深感興趣的創作團體，團員來自亞洲各地，熱衷於AI人工智能的影像創作，喜愛藝術、文化、機械、賽博格等未來想像的景致。 作品曾於2025 臺中國家歌劇院 Arts NOVA 「摩登時代」、「新世紀浮世繪」、2024「你好，人類」、台灣文化科技大會主題展「G.A.M.E.」、「文化燉」芬蘭站及香港站、2023「香港微波新媒體國際藝術節」展出。

collectives.name: PHOSPHEN
collectives.description: PHOSPHEN is a creator of content and a designer of virtual reality technologies and immersive environments. At its core, its purpose is to craft unique experiences through existing immersive technologies… or those yet to be invented. Whether through interactivity, sensory engagement, or immersive audiovisual design, its ongoing pursuit is to create powerful emotional connections that audiences will remember for a long time.
collectives.description_zh_tw: PHOSPHEN 是一家內容創作公司，致力於設計虛擬實境技術與沉浸式環境。核心宗旨在於透過現有或尚未被發明的沉浸式技術，打造獨一無二的體驗。無論是透過交互作用、感官參與或是沉浸式影音設計，其不斷追求的是創造出能讓觀眾長久銘記的強大情感連結。

collectives.name: The Department of New Media Art of Taipei National University of the Arts
collectives.name_zh_tw: 國立臺北藝術大學新媒體藝術學系
collectives.display_name: The Department of New Media Art of Taipei National University of the Arts
collectives.description: The Department of New Media Art of Taipei National University of the Arts is the first department of its kind in the country. It breaks through the conventional boundaries of humanities and the arts to integrate cutting-edge technology and serves as an important promoter of the integration of digital technology and art to cultivate forward-looking creative talent in future art domains such as technology, images, and transdisciplinary works.
collectives.description_zh_tw: 為全國首創，是一跨越人文藝術領域與尖端科技結合的未來學門。作為推動數位科技與藝術整合的重要推手，培育前瞻性的「新媒體科技」、「新媒體影像」與「新媒體跨域」等藝術創意人才。

collectives.name: Interdisciplinary Program of Technology and Art, National Tsing Hua University
collectives.name_zh_tw: 國立清華大學藝術學院學士班 / 科藝所
collectives.display_name: Interdisciplinary Program of Technology and Art, National Tsing Hua University
collectives.description: "Techno-Art" is a new form of contemporary art and an important trend in international art development. Established in 2018 at the National Tsing Hua University's College of Arts, it views the integration of technology and art as a professional field, aiming to cultivate future professionals in techno-art through cross-disciplinary creation and research.
collectives.description_zh_tw: 「科技藝術（Techno-Art）」是當代藝術的新形式創作也是國際藝術發展的重要趨勢，清大藝術學院自107學年成立，把「科技」與「藝術」結合視為「專業領域」，培育未來科技藝術跨域之專業創作與研究人才。

collectives.name: ​​The Department of Interaction Design of National Taipei University of Technology
collectives.display_name: ​​The Department of Interaction Design of National Taipei University of Technology
collectives.description: The department's vision is to meet the current and future manpower needs of industries in digital content, cultural and creative industries, information and communications technology (ICT), animation and gaming, mobile application services, Internet of Things (IoT), and social media, while nurturing students with forward-thinking, interdisciplinary, and cross-sector critical capabilities. The establishment of the Department of Interaction Design aligns with national industrial development needs, providing talent cultivation and training to meet market demands. It also fosters internationalized educational perspectives, equipping a new generation of designers with the essential knowledge and skills for the future.
collectives.description_zh_tw: 本系之願景為在配合現階段與未來國內外產業的人力需求為願景，於數位內容、文化創意、資通訊技術(ICT)、動畫遊戲、行動應用服務、物聯網(IoT)、社群媒體…等產業，培育學生具有前瞻性、跨產業、跨領域的關鍵能力。互動設計系的設置不僅符合國家未來產業發展的需求，提供所需人才的培養與訓練，更持續接軌與拓展國際化教育發展的視野，培育新一代設計師所應具備之本質學能。

collectives.name: YAO Jui-Chung × Yi KUO × Meuko Meuko
collectives.name_zh_tw: 姚瑞中 X 郭一 X Meuko! Meuko!
collectives.display_name: YAO Jui-Chung × Yi KUO × Meuko Meuko
collectives.description: The Mount Ecstasy project was initiated by contemporary artist YAO Jui-Chung, bringing his long-term observations on the "absurdity" of the human condition and the visual lexicon of "desire spectacles" found in Taiwanese folk religion into the digital realm. Serving as the original creator and concept director, YAO leads the narrative axis with his unique "Cold Reality" aesthetics, exploring the intertwining of karma and history. Visual production is led by director Yi KUO, NONTECH, and XTRUX, who reconstruct contemporary mythical rituals within a virtualized world. Experimental electronic musician Meuko Meuko infuses the work with profound sensory reflection through spiritual breakbeats and noise. Together, the team transforms painterly whimsy into an audiovisual revelry that merges technological hallucinations with historical memory.
collectives.description_zh_tw: 「虛迷山」計畫由當代藝術家姚瑞中發起，將其對人類處境「荒謬性」的長期觀察，以及台灣民間宗教中「欲力奇觀」的視覺語彙帶入數位領域。姚瑞中以其獨特的「冷現實」美學擔任原作與概念指導，引領整場創作的敘事軸心，探討業力與歷史的交織。影像導演郭一、NONTECH和XTRUX負責視覺製作，在虛擬化世界中重建當代神話儀式；實驗電音創作者Meuko Meuko則透過具靈性的碎拍與噪音，為作品注入深沉的感官思考。團隊共同將繪畫中的奇想轉化，建構出一場融合科技幻覺與歷史記憶的視聽狂歡。
